        { path: "index.ts", source: 'import { ALERT_KINDS } from "@korbat/contracts";' },
      ]),
    ).toEqual(["notify/main.ts: imports ../config, outside the watcher", "notify/push.ts: imports ../moderation, outside the watcher", "moderation/alerts.ts: imports ../notify/push, inside the watcher"]);
  });
});

/**
 * The hand-over's boundary (3f design, section 5 and invariant 16): handover.ts, an entry point of its own
 * (dist/handover.js), imports nothing under ./ (no module of the API, so no database, no configuration and no copy of
 * anything that could reach either) and only Node's own modules, none of which opens a socket or a process; nothing
 * imports it. And no file outside media/ but config.ts and index.ts names the store's directory setting, MEDIA_STORE_DIR:
 * the store is read through the media module, or by the hand-over's program under its fixed mount.
 */
const SOCKET_MODULES = new Set(["node:net", "node:http", "node:https", "node:http2", "node:dgram", "node:tls", "node:child_process", "node:worker_threads", "node:cluster"]);
function findHandoverViolations(files: SourceFile[]): string[] {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  for (const { path, source } of files) {
    for (const spec of specifiers(source)) {
      if (path === "handover.ts") {
        if (spec.startsWith(".")) violations.push(`${path}: imports ${spec}, a module of the API`);
        else if (!spec.startsWith("node:")) violations.push(`${path}: imports ${spec}, which is not one of Node's own modules`);
        else if (SOCKET_MODULES.has(spec)) violations.push(`${path}: imports ${spec}, which can open a socket or a process`);
      } else if (spec.startsWith(".") && posix.normalize(posix.join(posix.dirname(path), spec)).replace(/[.]ts$/, "") === "handover") {
        violations.push(`${path}: imports ${spec}, the hand-over's program`);
      }
    }
    if (/MEDIA_STORE_DIR/.test(source) && !path.startsWith("media/") && path !== "config.ts" && path !== "index.ts") {
      violations.push(`${path}: names MEDIA_STORE_DIR, which only the media module, config.ts and index.ts may`);
    }
  }
  return violations;
}

describe("the hand-over's boundary (3f Task 5)", () => {
  test("handover.ts imports only Node's own modules and none that opens a socket, nothing imports it, and no file outside media/ but config.ts and index.ts names the store's directory setting", () => {
    const files = loadSources();
    expect(files.map((file) => file.path)).toContain("handover.ts");
    expect(findHandoverViolations(files)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("catches an import of an API module or a package from the hand-over, a socket's module, an import of the hand-over, and the store's setting named elsewhere", () => {
    expect(
      findHandoverViolations([
        { path: "handover.ts", source: 'import { storedImageName } from "./media"; import { sql } from "drizzle-orm"; import { connect } from "node:net"; import { crc32 } from "node:zlib";' },
        { path: "cli/records.ts", source: 'import { zipStored } from "../handover";' },
        { path: "cli/staff.ts", source: "const dir = env.MEDIA_STORE_DIR;" },
        { path: "media/files.ts", source: "const dir = config.MEDIA_STORE_DIR;" },
      ]),
    ).toEqual([
      "handover.ts: imports ./media, a module of the API",
      "handover.ts: imports drizzle-orm, which is not one of Node's own modules",
      "handover.ts: imports node:net, which can open a socket or a process",
      "cli/records.ts: imports ../handover, the hand-over's program",
      "cli/staff.ts: names MEDIA_STORE_DIR, which only the media module, config.ts and index.ts may",
    ]);
  });
});

/**
 * The quarantine's mover (3d design, section 5 "The services"; 12.1 rows 13 and 14): quarantine.ts, an entry point of its
 * own (dist/quarantine.js), is as bare as the hand-over: it imports nothing under ./ and only Node's own modules, none
 * that opens a socket or a process, and nothing imports it.
 */
function findQuarantineViolations(files: SourceFile[]): string[] {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  for (const { path, source } of files) {
    for (const spec of specifiers(source)) {
      if (path === "quarantine.ts") {
        if (spec.startsWith(".")) violations.push(`${path}: imports ${spec}, a module of the API`);
        else if (!spec.startsWith("node:")) violations.push(`${path}: imports ${spec}, which is not one of Node's own modules`);
        else if (SOCKET_MODULES.has(spec)) violations.push(`${path}: imports ${spec}, which can open a socket or a process`);
      } else if (spec.startsWith(".") && posix.normalize(posix.join(posix.dirname(path), spec)).replace(/[.]ts$/, "") === "quarantine") {
        violations.push(`${path}: imports ${spec}, the quarantine's mover`);
      }
    }
  }
  return violations;
}

const REPO_ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL("../../../", import.meta.url));
const LF = String.fromCharCode(10);

/** The service blocks of a Compose file's services section, by name, as text: from a service's name to the next one's. */
function composeServices(text: string): Map<string, string> {
  const head = `${LF}services:${LF}`;
  const section = text.slice(text.indexOf(head) + head.length - 1);
  // The section ends at the next top-level key.
  const end = section.slice(1).search(new RegExp(`${LF}[a-z][a-z0-9_-]*:`));
  const body = end === -1 ? section : section.slice(0, end + 1);
  const blocks = new Map<string, string>();
  const names = [...body.matchAll(new RegExp(`${LF} {2}([a-z][a-z0-9_-]*):${LF}`, "g"))];
  names.forEach((match, i) => blocks.set(match[1]!, body.slice(match.index!, names[i + 1]?.index ?? body.length)));
  return blocks;
}

/**
 * Who mounts the quarantine (3d design, section 5; 12.1 row 14): in compose.yml only `quarantine`, read-write, and
 * `handover`, read-only, name the volume media-quarantine, and compose.dev.yml names it nowhere, so neither the api, the
 * migrate nor the worker service mounts it. The mover has no network, no environment, every capability dropped, a
 * read-only root and the two volumes alone; the worker keeps network_mode: none.
 */
function findComposeViolations(compose: string, dev: string): string[] {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  const services = composeServices(compose);
  for (const [name, block] of services) {
    const mounts = block.split(LF).filter((line) => line.includes("media-quarantine"));
    if (mounts.length === 0) continue;
    const expected = name === "quarantine" ? "- media-quarantine:/media/quarantine" : name === "handover" ? "- media-quarantine:/media/quarantine:ro" : null;
    if (expected === null) violations.push(`compose.yml: ${name} names media-quarantine`);
    else if (mounts.map((line) => line.trim()).join("|") !== expected) violations.push(`compose.yml: ${name} mounts media-quarantine otherwise than ${expected}`);
  }
  for (const [name, block] of composeServices(dev)) {
    if (block.includes("media-quarantine")) violations.push(`compose.dev.yml: ${name} names media-quarantine`);
  }
  const mover = services.get("quarantine");
  if (!mover) violations.push("compose.yml: no service quarantine");
  else {
    for (const line of ["network_mode: none", "read_only: true", "cap_drop: [ALL]", '"no-new-privileges:true"', 'profiles: ["quarantine"]', 'entrypoint: ["node", "dist/quarantine.js", "/media/store", "/media/quarantine"]']) {
      if (!mover.includes(line)) violations.push(`compose.yml: quarantine lacks ${line}`);
    }
    for (const key of ["environment:", "env_file:", "networks:", "ports:", "secrets:"]) {
      if (mover.includes(key)) violations.push(`compose.yml: quarantine has ${key}`);
    }
    const volumes = mover
      .split(LF)
      .filter((line) => /^ {6}- /.test(line))
      .map((line) => line.trim());
    if (volumes.join("|") !== "- media-store:/media/store|- media-quarantine:/media/quarantine") violations.push(`compose.yml: quarantine mounts ${volumes.join(", ")}`);
  }
  if (!services.get("worker")?.includes("network_mode: none")) violations.push("compose.yml: worker has a network");
  violations.push(...findImporterViolations(services, composeServices(dev)));
  return violations;
}

/** A service's lines that are not comments: what Compose reads of it. */
const serviceLines = (block: string): string[] => block.split(LF).filter((line) => !line.trim().startsWith("#"));
/** The lines of a service that name one of the two import volumes. */
const importMounts = (block: string): string[] => serviceLines(block).filter((line) => line.includes("import-archives") || line.includes("import-work")).map((line) => line.trim());

/**
 * 3b (design, section 7.1; decision 1): the importer parses archives people upload, hostile input. Like the worker it has
 * no network and no capability; it reads import-archives read-only and writes import-work, and the API mounts the two
 * the other way round. No other service names either volume, and the development file names neither.
 */
function findImporterViolations(services: Map<string, string>, dev: Map<string, string>): string[] {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  const expected: Record<string, string> = {
    importer: "- import-archives:/import/archives:ro|- import-work:/import/work",
    api: "- import-archives:/import/archives|- import-work:/import/work:ro",
  };
  for (const [name, block] of services) {
    const mounts = importMounts(block);
    if (mounts.length === 0 && expected[name] === undefined) continue;
    if (expected[name] === undefined) violations.push(`compose.yml: ${name} names an import volume`);
    else if (mounts.join("|") !== expected[name]) violations.push(`compose.yml: ${name} mounts the import volumes otherwise than ${expected[name]}`);
  }
  for (const [name, block] of dev) {
    if (importMounts(block).length > 0) violations.push(`compose.dev.yml: ${name} names an import volume`);
  }
  const importer = services.get("importer");
  if (!importer) return [...violations, "compose.yml: no service importer"];
  const lines = serviceLines(importer).map((line) => line.trim());
  for (const line of ["network_mode: none", "cap_drop: [ALL]"]) if (!lines.includes(line)) violations.push(`compose.yml: importer lacks ${line}`);
  for (const key of ["networks:", "ports:", "env_file:", "secrets:"]) if (lines.some((line) => line.startsWith(key))) violations.push(`compose.yml: importer has ${key}`);
  return violations;
}

describe("the quarantine's boundary (3d Task 1)", () => {
  test("quarantine.ts imports only Node's own modules and none that opens a socket, and nothing imports it", () => {
    const files = loadSources();
    expect(files.map((file) => file.path)).toContain("quarantine.ts");
    expect(findQuarantineViolations(files)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("catches an import of an API module or a package from the mover, a socket's module, and an import of the mover", () => {
    expect(
      findQuarantineViolations([
        { path: "quarantine.ts", source: 'import { storedImageName } from "./media"; import { z } from "zod"; import { request } from "node:https"; import { open } from "node:fs/promises";' },
        { path: "cli/custody.ts", source: 'import { runQuarantine } from "../quarantine";' },
      ]),
    ).toEqual([
      "quarantine.ts: imports ./media, a module of the API",
      "quarantine.ts: imports zod, which is not one of Node's own modules",
      "quarantine.ts: imports node:https, which can open a socket or a process",
      "cli/custody.ts: imports ../quarantine, the quarantine's mover",
    ]);
  });

  test("only quarantine (read-write) and handover (read-only) mount media-quarantine; the mover is bare and the worker keeps no network", () => {
    const compose = readFileSync(join(REPO_ROOT, "infra", "compose.yml"), "utf8");
    const dev = readFileSync(join(REPO_ROOT, "infra", "compose.dev.yml"), "utf8");
    expect([...composeServices(compose).keys()]).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["api", "migrate", "worker", "importer", "handover", "quarantine"]));
    expect(findComposeViolations(compose, dev)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("catches the volume in the api or the development file, a writable hand-over and a mover with an environment", () => {
    const compose = readFileSync(join(REPO_ROOT, "infra", "compose.yml"), "utf8");
    const dev = readFileSync(join(REPO_ROOT, "infra", "compose.dev.yml"), "utf8");
    const broken = compose
      .replace(`      - media-store:/media/store:ro${LF}      - media-quarantine:/media/quarantine:ro`, `      - media-store:/media/store:ro${LF}      - media-quarantine:/media/quarantine`)
      .replace(`      - media-uploads:/media/uploads${LF}`, `      - media-uploads:/media/uploads${LF}      - media-quarantine:/media/quarantine:ro${LF}`)
      .replace(`    profiles: ["quarantine"]${LF}`, `    profiles: ["quarantine"]${LF}    environment:${LF}      X: "1"${LF}`);
    const devBroken = dev.replace(`  api:${LF}`, `  api:${LF}    volumes: [media-quarantine:/media/quarantine]${LF}`);
    expect(findComposeViolations(broken, devBroken)).toEqual([
      "compose.yml: api names media-quarantine",
      "compose.yml: handover mounts media-quarantine otherwise than - media-quarantine:/media/quarantine:ro",
      "compose.dev.yml: api names media-quarantine",
      "compose.yml: quarantine has environment:",
    ]);
  });

  test("3b: catches an importer with a network or a writable archive volume, an import volume in another service or in the development file", () => {
    const compose = readFileSync(join(REPO_ROOT, "infra", "compose.yml"), "utf8");
    const dev = readFileSync(join(REPO_ROOT, "infra", "compose.dev.yml"), "utf8");
    const broken = compose
      .replace(`      - import-archives:/import/archives:ro${LF}`, `      - import-archives:/import/archives${LF}`)
      .replace(`      dockerfile: apps/importer/Dockerfile${LF}    network_mode: none${LF}`, `      dockerfile: apps/importer/Dockerfile${LF}    networks: [app]${LF}`)
      .replace(`      - media-uploads:/media/uploads:ro${LF}      - media-store:/media/store${LF}`, `      - media-uploads:/media/uploads:ro${LF}      - media-store:/media/store${LF}      - import-work:/import/work:ro${LF}`);
    const devBroken = dev.replace(`  api:${LF}`, `  api:${LF}    volumes: [import-archives:/import/archives]${LF}`);
    expect(findComposeViolations(broken, devBroken)).toEqual([
      "compose.yml: worker names an import volume",
      "compose.yml: importer mounts the import volumes otherwise than - import-archives:/import/archives:ro|- import-work:/import/work",
      "compose.dev.yml: api names an import volume",
      "compose.yml: importer lacks network_mode: none",
      "compose.yml: importer has networks:",
    ]);
    expect(findComposeViolations(compose.replace(`${LF}  importer:${LF}`, `${LF}  importer2:${LF}`), dev)).toEqual(["compose.yml: importer2 names an import volume", "compose.yml: no service importer"]);
  });
});

/**
 * The adapters' files (3d design, section 5 "The adapters"): each adapter is a file of its own that imports nothing of its
 * module, so it is given what its interface names and nothing more: no media file, no repository and no database. Task
 * 3 builds the first, the edge's purge (media/edge-adapter.ts), and Task 5 the head's witness (transparency/witness.ts);
 * the matcher's (media/match-adapter.ts) joins this list with the task that builds it. A package import that is no
 * database stays allowed: the adapter reads its numbers from the contracts.
 */
const ADAPTER_FILES = ["media/edge-adapter.ts", "transparency/witness.ts", "media/match-adapter.ts"];
function findAdapterViolations(files: SourceFile[]): string[] {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  for (const { path, source } of files) {
    if (!ADAPTER_FILES.includes(path)) continue;
    for (const spec of specifiers(source)) {
      if (spec.startsWith(".")) violations.push(`${path}: imports ${spec}, a file of the API`);
      else if (spec.startsWith("@korbat/db")) violations.push(`${path}: imports ${spec}, the database`);
    }
  }
  return violations;
}

describe("the adapters' files (3d Task 3)", () => {

    const files = loadSources();

    expect(findAdapterViolations(files)).toEqual([]);

    expect(

        { path: "media/edge-adapter.ts", source: 'import { createMediaRepo } from "./repo"; import type { MediaDeps } from "./context"; import { postMedia } from "@korbat/db"; import { EDGE_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";' },
        { path: "media/edge.ts", source: 'import { createMediaRepo } from "./repo";' },
      ]),
    ).toEqual(["media/edge-adapter.ts: imports ./repo, a file of the API", "media/edge-adapter.ts: imports ./context, a file of the API", "media/edge-adapter.ts: imports @korbat/db, the database"]);
    expect(findAdapterViolations([{ path: "media/edge-adapter.ts", source: 'import { media } from "../media";' }])).toEqual(["media/edge-adapter.ts: imports ../media, a file of the API"]);
    // Task 5: the witness's file imports nothing of the transparency module, no repository and no database.
    expect(
      findAdapterViolations([
        { path: "transparency/witness.ts", source: 'import { createTransparencyRepo } from "./repo"; import { headPublications } from "@korbat/db"; import { HEAD_RULES } from "@korbat/contracts";' },
        { path: "transparency/head.ts", source: 'import { createTransparencyRepo } from "./repo";' },
      ]),
    ).toEqual(["transparency/witness.ts: imports ./repo, a file of the API", "transparency/witness.ts: imports @korbat/db, the database"]);
    // Task 7: the matcher's file imports nothing of the media module, no repository and no database: it is given hashes.
    expect(
      findAdapterViolations([
        { path: "media/match-adapter.ts", source: 'import { createMatchRepo } from "./match-repo"; import { mediaHashes } from "@korbat/db"; import { MATCH_FIXTURES } from "@korbat/media-protocol";' },
        { path: "media/match.ts", source: 'import { createMatchRepo } from "./match-repo";' },
      ]),
    ).toEqual(["media/match-adapter.ts: imports ./match-repo, a file of the API", "media/match-adapter.ts: imports @korbat/db, the database"]);
  });
});

/**
 * The transparency module (3d design, section 5, "The architecture test"; Task 4): it reads no session and no table of a
 * person, so a file under transparency/ imports from @korbat/db no schema name but those of schema/transparency.ts (Task 5
 * adds head_publications there) and the audit head, and no namespace of it. Db and DbTx, which are no schema names, stay
 * allowed.
 */
const TRANSPARENCY_SCHEMA_FILE = "transparency.ts";
const TRANSPARENCY_EXTRA_NAMES = new Set(["auditHead"]);

function findTransparencyViolations(files: SourceFile[], schemaNames: Set<string>, allowed: Set<string>): string[] {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  for (const { path, source } of files) {
    if (!path.startsWith("transparency/")) continue;
    for (const name of dbImports(source)) {
      if (name === "*") violations.push(`${path}: namespace import of @korbat/db (the transparency module names its own tables only)`);
      else if (schemaNames.has(name) && !allowed.has(name)) violations.push(`${path}: imports ${name} from @korbat/db, which is no table of the public figures`);
    }
  }
  return violations;
}

    expect([...allowed()].sort()).toEqual(["auditHead", "headPublications", "recipientMonths", "transparencyEditions"]);
    expect(findTransparencyViolations(files, schemaNames(), allowed())).toEqual([]);

  test("catches a table of a person, an auth table and a namespace import, and allows its own tables, the head and the pool's types", () => {
    const files: SourceFile[] = [
      { path: "transparency/repo.ts", source: `import { transparencyEditions, recipientMonths, auditHead, decisions, type Db, type DbTx } from "@korbat/db";` },

/**
 * 2d's tables (design, sections 5.3, 5.4 and 12.2; Task 2). One table of pins: the files that may name each table of the
 * migration activity, in SQL or by drizzle's name, as a whole word, comments included. Entries are written only by the
 * social repository, in the act's transaction (createPost, follow), and deleted there (deletePost, block, the purge); the
 * activity module reads them, keeps the seen marker and the rules, and runs the retention; the mentions are the social
 * module's alone, read by its repository for the views. As an assertion of its own, the one insert into post_mentions is
 * in createPost, so a mention is added only with its post. And the staff and moderation modules never import the activity
 * module or name its tables: no staff route reads Activity, and moderation entries are never written, only read.
 */
const ACTIVITY_TABLE_PINS: { table: string; names: string[]; allowed: (path: string) => boolean }[] = [
  { table: "activity_items", names: ["activity_items", "activityItems"], allowed: (path) => path === "social/repo.ts" || insideActivity(path) },
  { table: "activity_state", names: ["activity_state", "activityState"], allowed: (path) => path === "social/repo.ts" || insideActivity(path) },
  { table: "post_mentions", names: ["post_mentions", "postMentions"], allowed: (path) => path === "social/repo.ts" || path === "social/views.ts" },
];
const MENTION_INSERT = /\binsert\s+into\s+(?:"?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?post_mentions\b|\.insert\(\s*postMentions\b/gi;

function findActivityTableViolations(files: SourceFile[]): string[] {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  for (const file of files) {
    for (const pin of ACTIVITY_TABLE_PINS) {
      const named = pin.names.filter((name) => mentions([file], name)[file.path] !== undefined);
      if (named.length > 0 && !pin.allowed(file.path)) violations.push(`${file.path}: names ${named.join(" and ")}, which only ${pin.table}'s pinned files may`);
    }
    if ((insideStaff(file.path) || insideModeration(file.path)) && specifiers(file.source).some((spec) => spec.startsWith(".") && /^activity(\/|$)/.test(posix.normalize(posix.join(posix.dirname(file.path), spec))))) {
      violations.push(`${file.path}: imports the activity module, which no staff or moderation file may`);
    }
  }
  return violations;
}

/** Where post_mentions is inserted into: each file, the number of inserts, and for social/repo.ts the method each is in. */
function mentionInserts(files: SourceFile[]): { path: string; count: number; inCreatePost: number }[] {
  return files.flatMap((file) => {
    const count = [...file.source.matchAll(MENTION_INSERT)].length;
    if (count === 0) return [];
    const start = file.source.indexOf("async createPost(");
    const end = start < 0 ? -1 : file.source.indexOf("async deletePost(", start);
    const inCreatePost = start < 0 || end < 0 ? 0 : [...file.source.slice(start, end).matchAll(MENTION_INSERT)].length;
    return [{ path: file.path, count, inCreatePost }];
  });
}

describe("2d's tables (5.3)", () => {
  test("each of activity_items, activity_state and post_mentions is named only in its pinned files, and the staff and moderation modules never import the activity module", () => {
    const files = loadSources();
    expect(files.map((file) => file.path)).toContain("activity/index.ts");
    expect(findActivityTableViolations(files)).toEqual([]);
    // The pins are about files that do name the tables.
    const named = (path: string, name: string) => mentions(files.filter((file) => file.path === path), name)[path] !== undefined;
    expect(named("social/repo.ts", "activity_items") && named("social/repo.ts", "activity_state") && named("social/repo.ts", "post_mentions")).toBe(true);
    expect(named("activity/repo.ts", "activity_items") && named("activity/repo.ts", "activity_state")).toBe(true);
  });

  test("the one insert into post_mentions is in social/repo.ts, inside createPost", () => {
    expect(mentionInserts(loadSources())).toEqual([{ path: "social/repo.ts", count: 1, inCreatePost: 1 }]);
  });

  test("catches a table named outside its files, by SQL or drizzle's name, a second insert of mentions, and the activity module imported by staff or moderation", () => {
    const files: SourceFile[] = [
      { path: "moderation/author.ts", source: "await q.execute(sql`select count(*) from activity_items where recipient_id = ${id}::uuid`);" },
      { path: "staff/cases.ts", source: 'import { activityState } from "@korbat/db";\nimport { createActivity } from "../activity";' },
      { path: "media/repo.ts", source: "await tx.execute(sql`delete from post_mentions where post_id = ${id}::uuid`);" },
      { path: "activity/repo.ts", source: "sql`select handle from post_mentions`" },
      { path: "moderation/release.ts", source: 'import type { ActivityForAccount } from "../activity/index";' },
      // Allowed: the social repository and the activity module, and a word that only contains a table's name.
      { path: "social/repo.ts", source: "sql`insert into activity_items (recipient_id) select 1`; sql`delete from activity_state`; sql`insert into post_mentions values (1)`;" },
      { path: "activity/flows.ts", source: "sql`select seen_at from activity_state`; const activity_items_insert = 1;" },
      { path: "account/flows/export.ts", source: 'import type { ActivityExport } from "../../activity";' },
    ];
    expect(findActivityTableViolations(files)).toEqual([
      "moderation/author.ts: names activity_items, which only activity_items's pinned files may",
      "staff/cases.ts: names activityState, which only activity_state's pinned files may",
      "staff/cases.ts: imports the activity module, which no staff or moderation file may",
      "media/repo.ts: names post_mentions, which only post_mentions's pinned files may",
      "activity/repo.ts: names post_mentions, which only post_mentions's pinned files may",
      "moderation/release.ts: imports the activity module, which no staff or moderation file may",
    ]);
    const twice: SourceFile[] = [
      { path: "social/repo.ts", source: "async createPost() { sql`insert into post_mentions (post_id) values (1)` } async deletePost() {} async publishImportedBatch() { sql`INSERT INTO public.post_mentions select 1` }" },
      { path: "social/views.ts", source: "await tx.insert(postMentions).values(rows);" },
    ];
    expect(mentionInserts(twice)).toEqual([
      { path: "social/repo.ts", count: 2, inCreatePost: 1 },
      { path: "social/views.ts", count: 1, inCreatePost: 0 },
    ]);
  });

  test("catches a deep import into the activity module and the auth schema inside it", () => {
    const files: SourceFile[] = [
      { path: "app.ts", source: `import { createActivityRepo } from "./activity/repo";\nimport { createActivity } from "./activity";` },
      { path: "account/flows/export.ts", source: `import type { ReceivedEntry } from "../../activity/flows";` },
      { path: "activity/repo.ts", source: `import { users, type Db } from "@korbat/db";` },
    ];
    expect(findViolations(files, new Set(), new Set(["users"]))).toEqual([
      "app.ts: imports ./activity/repo, which is inside the activity module (use ./activity)",
      "account/flows/export.ts: imports ../../activity/flows, which is inside the activity module (use ./activity)",
      "activity/repo.ts: imports auth-schema users from @korbat/db",
    ]);
  });
});

/**
 * 3d review H3: the recipients' count (the day's salt and the sketches of accounts and readers) lives in a Valkey of its
 * own that writes nothing to disk, never in the shared one, whose append-only file keeps every write. In the API the
 * transparency module is given one store, `counts`, which index.ts builds from COUNTS_URL alone, and no file of the
 * module names the shared client or REDIS_URL. In compose.yml the service `counts` runs the redis service's own pinned
 * image with persistence off, on the data network alone, with no volume and no published port, and the API's COUNTS_URL
 * names it.
 */
function findCountsViolations(files: SourceFile[], compose: string): string[] {
  const violations: string[] = [];
  const index = files.find((file) => file.path === "index.ts")?.source ?? "";
  if (!/const counts = new Redis[(]config[.]COUNTS_URL,/.test(index)) violations.push("index.ts: builds no counts client from COUNTS_URL");
  const call = /createTransparency[(][{]([^}]*)[}][)]/.exec(index)?.[1] ?? "";
  if (!/(^|[ ,])counts([ ,]|$)/.test(call) || /(^|[ ,])redis([ ,:]|$)/.test(call)) violations.push(`index.ts: createTransparency is given ${call.trim()}`);
  for (const { path, source } of files) {
    if (!path.startsWith("transparency/")) continue;
    if (/REDIS_URL|[^a-zA-Z]redis[^a-zA-Z]/.test(source.replace(/import type Redis from "ioredis";/, ""))) violations.push(`${path}: names the shared Valkey`);
  }
  const services = composeServices(compose);
  const counts = services.get("counts");
  const image = (block: string | undefined) => /^ {4}image: (.+)$/m.exec(block ?? "")?.[1];
  if (!counts) violations.push("compose.yml: no service counts");
  else {
    if (image(counts) === undefined || image(counts) !== image(services.get("redis"))) violations.push("compose.yml: counts runs another image than redis");
    for (const flag of ["--appendonly no", "--save ''", "--requirepass $$REDIS_PASSWORD"]) if (!counts.includes(flag)) violations.push(`compose.yml: counts lacks ${flag}`);
    for (const key of ["volumes:", "ports:", "env_file:"]) if (counts.includes(key)) violations.push(`compose.yml: counts has ${key}`);
    if (!counts.includes("networks: [data]")) violations.push("compose.yml: counts is not on the data network alone");
  }
  if (!services.get("api")?.includes("COUNTS_URL: redis://:${REDIS_PASSWORD}@counts:6379")) violations.push("compose.yml: the api's COUNTS_URL does not name counts");
  return violations;
}

describe("the recipients' count keeps nothing on disk (3d review H3)", () => {
  test("the transparency module is given the counts store alone, built from COUNTS_URL; compose's counts writes nothing to disk", () => {
    const compose = readFileSync(join(REPO_ROOT, "infra", "compose.yml"), "utf8");
    expect(findCountsViolations(loadSources(), compose)).toEqual([]);
  });

  test("catches the shared client handed to the module, a volume, persistence and another image", () => {
    const compose = readFileSync(join(REPO_ROOT, "infra", "compose.yml"), "utf8");
    const files = loadSources().map((file) => (file.path === "index.ts" ? { ...file, source: file.source.replace(/createTransparency[(][{]([^}]*)[}][)]/, "createTransparency({ apiDb, redis, auth: auth.forTransparency, config, logger })") } : file));
    const counts = composeServices(compose).get("counts") ?? "";
    // A function as the replacement, so the dollar signs of the block stay as they are.
    const broken = compose.replace(counts, () => counts.replace("--appendonly no", "--appendonly yes").replace("    networks: [data]", `    volumes:${LF}      - valkeydata:/data${LF}    networks: [data]`));
    expect(findCountsViolations(files, broken)).toEqual([
      "index.ts: createTransparency is given apiDb, redis, auth: auth.forTransparency, config, logger",
      "compose.yml: counts lacks --appendonly no",
      "compose.yml: counts has volumes:",
    ]);
  });
});

  test("3e: a suspended account deletes itself its 1b way, with no hold: the purge takes the rows of its followers and those it follows before any post, writes their counters exactly, and writes no standing into the deleted row", async () => {

  test("3e: the take-down of a terminated account, as the system: the row marked deleted and its sessions revoked as a confirmation leaves them, the event marked a termination's, termination_final to the address read before it and never account_deleted; a second call changes and mails nothing, and the round's purge finishes it", async () => {
    const owner = await account();

  test("3f: with an address held for a report, the deletion takes everything down at once but the address: the credentials go in the purge's first statement, the address and purged_at wait, the mail gains the hold's paragraph, and the next round after the hold is released overwrites the address", async () => {
    const owner = await account();
    const userId = owner.user.id;
    await authRepo.setPhoneHash(userId, randomBytes(16).toString("hex"));
    // 3f's review (proofs9): two-factor on, so that the check below of the secret and the codes proves their clearing.
    await authRepo.enableTotp(userId, { secretEnc: "v1:held-account", recoveryCodesHash: ["code-a", "code-b"], now: new Date() });
    expect(await authRow(userId)).toMatchObject({ totpSecretEnc: "v1:held-account", recoveryCodesHash: ["code-a", "code-b"] });
    // A seal taken while deciding holds the account's record: its hold, as report_open sets it, written as the migrator.
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into auth.report_holds (user_id, set_at, seal_final) values (${userId}::uuid, now(), false)`);
    try {
      const { flowId } = await startDeletion(deps(), owner.session, h.ctx);
      await confirmDeletion(deps(), owner.session, { flowId, code: h.mailer.lastCodeFor(owner.email)!, handle: owner.handle });
      // Everything but the address went at once: the credentials and personal facts, the profile, the sessions.
      const held = (await authRow(userId))!;
      expect(held).toMatchObject({ email: owner.email, purgedAt: null, passwordHash: null, totpSecretEnc: null, totpEnabledAt: null, phoneHash: null, recoveryCodesHash: [], ageConfirmedAt: null, termsVersion: null, termsAcceptedAt: null });
      expect(held.deletedAt).not.toBeNull();
      expect(await s.repo.findProfileByHandle(owner.handle)).toBeNull();
      // The mail: the one wording for every account, and the paragraph of the seal taken while deciding, with its day.
      const mail = h.mailer.sent.filter((m) => m.to === owner.email && m.template === "account_deleted").at(-1)!;
      const [until] = await migrateDb.execute<{ day: string }>(sql`select to_char(auth.address_held_until(${userId}::uuid) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as day`);
      expect(mail.data).toEqual({ heldUntil: until!.day, holdFinal: "false" });
      // The account stays pending, last, and each round counts it as held and changes nothing.
      const first = await purgePending(deps());
      expect(first.held).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
      expect(await authRow(userId)).toMatchObject({ email: owner.email, purgedAt: null });
      const pending = await authRepo.pendingPurges();
      expect(pending.at(-1)).toBe(userId);
      // The record is sent: the hold is released, and the next round overwrites the address.
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`update auth.report_holds set released_at = now(), release_reason = 'sent' where user_id = ${userId}::uuid`);
      await purgePending(deps());
      expect(await authRow(userId)).toMatchObject({ email: `deleted:${userId}`, emailVerifiedAt: null });
      expect((await authRow(userId))!.purgedAt).not.toBeNull();
    } finally {
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from auth.report_holds where user_id = ${userId}::uuid`);
    }
  });

    const owner = await account();

      // As the migrator: the account's key, a done import with two posts (one disabled for an order) and one that publishes.

      await migrateDb.execute(sql`

        values (${done}::uuid, ${userId}::uuid, 'mastodon', 'done', 10, 10, now(), now(), now(), now(), ${choice}::jsonb, now(), 2),
               (${publishing}::uuid, ${userId}::uuid, 'x', 'publishing', 10, 10, now(), now(), now(), null, ${choice}::jsonb, now(), 0)`);
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`update import_jobs set seed = ${randomBytes(32)}::bytea where id = ${publishing}::uuid`);
      const [shown, disabled] = [randomUUID(), randomUUID()];
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`
        insert into posts (id, author_id, body, created_at, import_job_id, import_source, original_created_at, import_shortened, import_key)
        values (${shown}::uuid, ${userId}::uuid, 'imported one', now(), ${done}::uuid, 'mastodon', '2019-03-03T12:00:00Z', false, ${randomBytes(32)}::bytea),
               (${disabled}::uuid, ${userId}::uuid, 'imported two', now(), ${done}::uuid, 'mastodon', '2019-03-04T12:00:00Z', true, ${randomBytes(32)}::bytea)`);
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'disabled', moderation_level = 'disabled' where id = ${disabled}::uuid`);
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set post_count = 2 where id = ${userId}::uuid`);
      await authRepo.markDeleted(userId, new Date());

      // A batch of the publishing import comes while the purge holds the profile's row: it waits there, and then finds the
      // account deleted and its import gone, and writes nothing.
      let waiting: Promise<string | null> | null = null;
      const marker = `waiting batch ${randomUUID()}`;
      const purging: AccountDeps = {
        ...deps(),
        imports: {
          ...imports.forAccount,
          purgeOwner: async (tx, id) => {
            waiting = rejection(
              s.repo.publishImportedBatch(
                { id: publishing, ownerId: userId, source: "x", cursor: 0 },
                { lines: 1, posts: [{ id: randomUUID(), parentId: null, body: marker, originalCreatedAt: "2019-03-05T12:00:00Z", shortened: false, key: randomBytes(32).toString("hex"), images: [] }] },
                new Date(),
                async () => undefined,
              ),
            );
            await untilBlocked(apiDb, "as suspended from profiles where id");
            return imports.forAccount.purgeOwner(tx, id);
          },
        },
      };
      expect(await purge(purging, userId)).toBe("purged");
      expect(await waiting).toBe("not_found");
      // Every post a tombstone with nothing of its source, the disabled one too; no import row and no key is left.
      for (const id of [shown, disabled]) {
        const [row] = await migrateDb.execute<{ state: string; body: string; job: string | null; source: string | null; original: string | null; shortened: boolean | null; key: string | null }>(
          sql`select state::text as state, body, import_job_id as job, import_source::text as source, original_created_at::text as original, import_shortened as shortened, encode(import_key, 'hex') as key
                from posts where id = ${id}::uuid`,
        );
        expect(row, id).toEqual({ state: "deleted_by_author", body: "", job: null, source: null, original: null, shortened: null, key: null });
      }
      const [left] = await migrateDb.execute<{ jobs: number; keys: number; written: number }>(
        sql`select (select count(*)::int from import_jobs where owner_id = ${userId}::uuid) as jobs, (select count(*)::int from import_keys where owner_id = ${userId}::uuid) as keys,
                   (select count(*)::int from posts where body = ${marker}) as written`,
      );
      expect(left).toEqual({ jobs: 0, keys: 0, written: 0 });
      // After the commit, each import's work folder is asked of the importer.
      for (const id of [done, publishing]) expect(existsSync(imports.deps.files.archives.deletion(id)), id).toBe(true);
      // A second purge changes nothing.
      expect(await purge(purging, userId)).toBe("none");
    } finally {
      rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
    }
  });

function memorySink() {
  const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
  return {
    write: async (chunk: Uint8Array): Promise<void> => {
      chunks.push(Uint8Array.from(chunk));
    },
    bytes: (): Uint8Array => Buffer.concat(chunks),
  };

  }

  /** A whole passkey registration through the 1c flow: the options, the software authenticator's answer and the verification; answers the stored view. */
  async function register(session: Session, auth: SoftAuthenticator, name: string | undefined, flags: SoftFlags) {
    const { options } = await registerOptions(h.deps, session, { label: "Owner" });
    const response = auth.create({ rpId: options.rp.id!, challenge: options.challenge, origin: ORIGIN, userHandle: Buffer.from(options.user.id, "base64url"), flags });
    return (await registerVerify(h.deps, session, { name, response })).passkey;
  }

  test("an account with real uploads exports an archive whose images are the store's large.webp byte for byte, and whose JSON holds its rows and its passkeys without their keys", { timeout: 30_000 }, async () => {
    const owner = await account();
    const userId = owner.user.id;
    // A second live session on the same device, and a third one revoked: only the two live ones are listed.
    const second = await signIn(h.deps, owner.user, owner.device, h.ctx, { alertNewDevice: false, factors: { email: h.clock.ms() }, method: "email" });
    const revoked = await signIn(h.deps, owner.user, owner.device, h.ctx, { alertNewDevice: false, factors: { email: h.clock.ms() }, method: "email" });
    await h.deps.sessions.revoke(revoked.issued.session.handle, userId);
    // Two passkeys a minute apart on the harness clock, both from the signed-in device: a synced one, used once since, and a plain one never used.
    const laptopAt = h.clock.now();
    const laptop = await register(owner.session, new SoftAuthenticator(), "Laptop", ALL);
    h.clock.advance(MINUTE);
    const plainAt = h.clock.now();
    await register(owner.session, new SoftAuthenticator(), undefined, BARE);
    const usedAt = new Date();
    expect(await authRepo.claimPasskeyUse(laptop.id, 1, true, usedAt)).toBe(true);
    // The handle left behind is reserved in handle_history; the export lists both.
    const renamed = newHandle();
    expect((await s.repo.changeHandle(userId, renamed, s.clock.next())).ok).toBe(true);

    const [imageA, imageB] = [await m.readyImage(userId, { width: 1600, height: 1200 }), await m.readyImage(userId, { width: 900, height: 1600 })];
    const post = await createPost(s.deps, userId, {
      body: "two photos",
      media: [
        { id: imageA, alt: "a harbour at dawn" },
        { id: imageB, alt: "a lighthouse" },
      ],
    });
    const reply = await createPost(s.deps, userId, { body: "a reply, soon deleted", replyToId: post.id, media: [] });
    await deletePost(s.deps, userId, reply.id);
    // A ready image on no post is still the account's upload; one still processing and one that failed have no file to export.
    const loose = await m.readyImage(userId);
    await upload(m.deps, userId, m.jpeg());
    const failed = (await upload(m.deps, userId, m.jpeg())).id;
    m.worker.failed(failed, "corrupt_image");
    await status(m.deps, userId, failed);

    const [bob, eve, carol] = await Promise.all([s.established(), s.established(), s.established()]);
    const bobsPost = await createPost(s.deps, bob.id, { body: "bob's post", media: [] });
    expect(await s.repo.like(userId, bobsPost.id, s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
    expect(await s.repo.repost(userId, bobsPost.id, s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
    expect(await s.repo.bookmark(userId, bobsPost.id, s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
    expect(await s.repo.follow(userId, bob.id, s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
    expect(await s.repo.block(userId, eve.id, s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
    expect(await s.repo.mute(userId, carol.id, s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
    await authRepo.appendEvent({ userId, type: "profile_updated" });

    const plan = await buildExport(deps(), userId, owner.session.handle, new Date());
    const sink = memorySink();
    await writeExport(createZipWriter(sink.write), plan);
    const files = unzipSync(sink.bytes());
    expect(Object.keys(files).sort()).toEqual(["export.json", `media/${imageA}.webp`, `media/${imageB}.webp`, `media/${loose}.webp`].sort());
    for (const id of [imageA, imageB, loose]) {
      expect(Buffer.compare(Buffer.from(files[`media/${id}.webp`]!), readFileSync(m.files.store.image(id, "large"))), id).toBe(0);
    }
    const text = strFromU8(files["export.json"]!);
    const json = ExportFormat.parse(JSON.parse(text));
    expect(json.missingMedia).toEqual([]);

    expect(json.account).toMatchObject({ id: userId, email: owner.email, role: "user", mfaEnabled: false, hasPassword: true, verified: false, termsVersion: TEST_TERMS });
    expect(json.account.termsAcceptedAt).not.toBeNull();
    // Newest first, the times from the flows' clock and the use as it was written, and the device that added each by its label.
    expect(json.account.passkeys).toEqual([
      { name: "Passkey on the web", createdAt: plainAt.toISOString(), lastUsedAt: null, synced: false, createdOn: "Chrome on Windows" },
      { name: "Laptop", createdAt: laptopAt.toISOString(), lastUsedAt: usedAt.toISOString(), synced: true, createdOn: "Chrome on Windows" },
    ]);
    // In the archive's own text: exactly those five members, and nothing that identifies a key, not the passkey ids, the credential ids or the public keys.
    const raw = JSON.parse(text) as { account: { passkeys: Record<string, unknown>[] } };
    expect(raw.account.passkeys.map((passkey) => Object.keys(passkey))).toEqual(Array.from({ length: 2 }, () => ["name", "createdAt", "lastUsedAt", "synced", "createdOn"]));
    for (const row of await authRepo.listPasskeys(userId)) {
      for (const secret of [row.id, row.credentialId, row.publicKey]) expect(text, secret).not.toContain(secret);
    }
    // The archive's JSON is the document exactly as JSON.stringify writes it, the passkeys in their place inside the account.
    expect(text).toBe(JSON.stringify(raw, null, 2));
    // The live sessions under their handles, the ids the session list shows; the hash of a token, which is what the server
    // looks a session up by, is nowhere in the archive.
    expect(json.sessions.map((session) => session.id).sort()).toEqual([owner.session.handle, second.issued.session.handle].sort());
    expect(json.sessions.find((session) => session.id === owner.session.handle)!.current).toBe(true);
    expect(json.sessions.find((session) => session.id === second.issued.session.handle)!.current).toBe(false);
    for (const hash of [owner.session.sessionId, second.issued.session.sessionId, revoked.issued.session.sessionId]) expect(text, hash).not.toContain(hash);
    expect(json.devices).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(json.devices[0]!.platform).toBe("web");
    // The account's own events, newest first; the sign-ins are among them.
    expect(json.events[0]!.type).toBe("profile_updated");
    expect(json.events.map((event) => event.type)).toContain("signin_success");
    for (let i = 1; i < json.events.length; i++) expect(json.events[i]!.at <= json.events[i - 1]!.at).toBe(true);

    expect(json.profile).toMatchObject({ handle: renamed, displayName: "Owner", bio: "", handleHistory: [owner.handle, renamed] });
    expect(json.posts.map((p) => p.id)).toEqual([post.id, reply.id]);
    expect(json.posts[0]).toMatchObject({
      body: "two photos",
      state: "visible",
      deletedAt: null,
      media: [
        { id: imageA, file: `media/${imageA}.webp`, altText: "a harbour at dawn", width: 1600, height: 1200 },
        { id: imageB, file: `media/${imageB}.webp`, altText: "a lighthouse", width: 900, height: 1600 },
      ],
    });
    expect(json.posts[1]).toMatchObject({ body: "", state: "deleted_by_author", replyToId: post.id, media: [] });
    expect(json.posts[1]!.deletedAt).not.toBeNull();
    expect(json.likes.map((ref) => ref.postId)).toEqual([bobsPost.id]);
    expect(json.reposts.map((ref) => ref.postId)).toEqual([bobsPost.id]);
    expect(json.bookmarks.map((ref) => ref.postId)).toEqual([bobsPost.id]);
    expect(json.following).toEqual([{ handle: bob.handle, since: expect.any(String) }]);
    expect(json.blocks).toEqual([{ handle: eve.handle, since: expect.any(String) }]);
    expect(json.mutes).toEqual([{ handle: carol.handle, since: expect.any(String) }]);
  });

  test("export.json read in keyset pages of two is, byte for byte, the document read in pages of a thousand; rows that share a moment are neither lost nor repeated", async () => {
    const owner = await account();
    const userId = owner.user.id;
    const [bob, ...others] = await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: 10 }, () => s.established()));
    const posts: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) posts.push(await newPost(s.repo, userId, s.clock.next(), `post ${i}`));
    const bobsPosts: string[] = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) bobsPosts.push(await newPost(s.repo, bob!.id, s.clock.next(), `bob ${i}`));
    // Five likes at one moment: within it the post id orders them, and a page may end between two of them.
    const moment = s.clock.next();
    for (const post of bobsPosts) expect(await s.repo.like(userId, post, moment)).toBe(true);
    // Three reposts a microsecond apart inside one millisecond, as a database default writes them: a page key cut to the
    // millisecond would read the same rows again or skip some.
    for (const [i, post] of bobsPosts.slice(0, 3).entries()) {
      await apiDb.execute(sql`insert into reposts (user_id, post_id, created_at) values (${userId}::uuid, ${post}::uuid, ${`2026-01-01T00:00:00.12345${i}Z`}::timestamptz)`);
    }
    for (const post of bobsPosts.slice(0, 4)) expect(await s.repo.bookmark(userId, post, s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
    for (const other of others.slice(0, 5)) expect(await s.repo.follow(userId, other.id, moment)).toBe(true);
    for (const other of others.slice(5, 8)) expect(await s.repo.block(userId, other.id, s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
    for (const other of others.slice(0, 3)) expect(await s.repo.mute(userId, other.id, s.clock.next())).toBe(true);

    const now = new Date();
    const paged = await collect(exportJson(await buildExport(deps(), userId, owner.session.handle, now, 2)));
    const whole = await collect(exportJson(await buildExport(deps(), userId, owner.session.handle, now)));
    expect(paged).toBe(whole);
    expect(paged).toBe(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(paged), null, 2));
    const json = ExportFormat.parse(JSON.parse(paged));
    expect(json.posts.map((post) => post.id)).toEqual(posts);
    expect(json.likes.map((like) => like.postId)).toEqual([...bobsPosts].sort());
    expect(json.reposts.map((repost) => [repost.postId, repost.at])).toEqual(bobsPosts.slice(0, 3).map((post) => [post, "2026-01-01T00:00:00.123Z"]));
    expect(json.bookmarks.map((bookmark) => bookmark.postId)).toEqual(bobsPosts.slice(0, 4));
    const byId = (list: { id: string; handle: string }[]) => [...list].sort((a, b) => (a.id < b.id ? -1 : 1)).map((profile) => profile.handle);
    expect(json.following.map((ref) => ref.handle)).toEqual(byId(others.slice(0, 5)));
    expect(json.blocks.map((ref) => ref.handle)).toEqual(others.slice(5, 8).map((profile) => profile.handle));
    expect(json.mutes.map((ref) => ref.handle)).toEqual(others.slice(0, 3).map((profile) => profile.handle));
  });

  test("3b Task 6 (11.2): an imported post carries its source, the archive's date and its mark, a deleted one none; the document ends with the account's imports, newest first, with their choice and counts", async () => {
    const owner = await account();
    const userId = owner.user.id;
    const root = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-export-imports-"));
    const imports = createImports({
      apiDb,
      archivesDir: path.join(root, "archives"),
      workDir: path.join(root, "work"),
      settings: importSettingsFrom(loadConfig()),
      auth: {} as never,
      social: {} as never,
      media: {} as never,
      moderation: {} as never,
      profiles: {} as never,
      rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(),
      requireSession: async (_c, next) => next(),
      logger: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    });
    const [done, cancelled] = [randomUUID(), randomUUID()];
    const [kept, deleted] = [randomUUID(), randomUUID()];
    const choice = { from: "2019-01", to: null, replies: true, warnings: false, protected: false, images: false, long: "shorten" };
    try {
      // As the migrator: a published import, confirmed with its choice, and an older one cancelled before any choice.
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`
        insert into import_jobs (id, owner_id, source, status, declared_bytes, received_bytes, created_at, uploaded_at, scanned_at, confirmed_at, ended_at, choice, stated_at, posts_published, posts_removed)
        values (${done}::uuid, ${userId}::uuid, 'mastodon', 'done', 10, 10, now() - interval '1 day', now(), now(), now(), now(), ${JSON.stringify(choice)}::jsonb, now() - interval '1 hour', 2, 0),
               (${cancelled}::uuid, ${userId}::uuid, 'x', 'cancelled', 10, 0, now() - interval '2 days', null, null, null, now() - interval '2 days', null, null, 0, 0)`);
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`
        insert into posts (id, author_id, body, created_at, import_job_id, import_source, original_created_at, import_shortened, import_key)
        values (${kept}::uuid, ${userId}::uuid, 'kept from the archive', now(), ${done}::uuid, 'mastodon', '2019-03-03T12:00:00Z', true, ${randomBytes(32)}::bytea),
               (${deleted}::uuid, ${userId}::uuid, 'deleted later', now(), ${done}::uuid, 'mastodon', '2019-03-04T12:00:00Z', false, ${randomBytes(32)}::bytea)`);
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set post_count = 2 where id = ${userId}::uuid`);
      // The author deletes one from its menu: its tombstone keeps nothing of its source.
      await deletePost(s.deps, userId, deleted);
      const text = await collect(exportJson(await buildExport({ ...deps(), imports: imports.forAccount }, userId, owner.session.handle, new Date())));
      const document = ExportFormat.parse(JSON.parse(text));
      // 2d (11.2) moved the pin: the account's Activity follows the imports.
      expect(Object.keys(JSON.parse(text) as object).slice(-2)).toEqual(["imports", "activity"]);
      const byId = new Map(document.posts.map((post) => [post.id, post]));
      expect(byId.get(kept)!.imported).toEqual({ source: "mastodon", originalCreatedAt: "2019-03-03T12:00:00.000Z", shortened: true });
      expect(byId.get(deleted)!).toMatchObject({ state: "deleted_by_author", body: "", imported: null });
      expect(document.imports.map((entry) => [entry.id, entry.status, entry.source])).toEqual([
        [done, "done", "mastodon"],
        [cancelled, "cancelled", "x"],
      ]);
      expect(document.imports[0]).toMatchObject({ choice, counts: { postsPublished: 2, postsRemoved: 0, imagesKept: 0, imagesLeftOut: 0 } });
      expect(document.imports[0]!.statedAt).not.toBeNull();
      expect(document.imports[1]).toMatchObject({ choice: null, statedAt: null });
      // Never a file, an archive's name or a handle: the entries hold the format's members alone.
      expect(Object.keys((JSON.parse(text) as { imports: object[] }).imports[0]!)).toEqual(["id", "source", "status", "createdAt", "endedAt", "statedAt", "choice", "counts"]);
    } finally {
      rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true });
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from posts where id in (${kept}::uuid, ${deleted}::uuid)`);
      await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from import_jobs where id in (${done}::uuid, ${cancelled}::uuid)`);
    }
  });

  test("2d (11.2): the preview switch, each post's mentions as written and its hidden counts, and the account's Activity last: its marker, its rules and every entry it received, newest first and ungrouped, with why the list does not show one", async () => {
    const owner = await account();
    const userId = owner.user.id;
    const [bob, cat, dan, eve, fay, gus] = await Promise.all([s.established(), s.established(), s.established(), s.established(), s.established(), s.established()]);
    const activity = createActivity({ apiDb, social: {} as never, rateLimitStore: new MemoryStore(), requireSession: async (_c, next) => next(), logger: pino({ level: "silent" }) });
    const read = async () => ExportFormat.parse(JSON.parse(await collect(exportJson(await buildExport({ ...deps(), activity: activity.forAccount }, userId, owner.session.handle, new Date(), 2)))));

    // Before anything: previews off, the rules' defaults, no marker and no entry.
    const bare = await read();
    expect(bare.profile.sharePreviews).toBe(false);
    expect(bare.activity).toEqual({ seenAt: null, settings: { ...ACTIVITY_DEFAULTS }, received: [] });

    expect(await s.repo.setSharePreviews(userId, true)).toBe(true);
    // A post that names Bob and Cat, its counts hidden; Cat renames afterwards: the export keeps the handle as written.
    const named = await createPost(s.deps, userId, { body: `thanks @${bob.handle} and @${cat.handle}`, media: [], hideCounts: true });
    const catHandle = cat.handle;
    expect((await s.repo.changeHandle(cat.id, newHandle(), s.clock.next())).ok).toBe(true);
    // What the owner receives: a reply shown; a mention from an account it mutes; a reply withheld since; a follow undone;
    // a mention written while a block was made (5.6's race), hidden only by the block; a reply of an account deleted since.
    const shown = await createPost(s.deps, bob.id, { body: "a reply", replyToId: named.id, media: [] });
    const muted = await createPost(s.deps, cat.id, { body: `hello @${owner.handle}`, media: [] });
    expect(await s.repo.mute(userId, cat.id, s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
    const withheld = await createPost(s.deps, dan.id, { body: "a reply withheld since", replyToId: named.id, media: [] });
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'withheld', moderation_level = 'withheld' where id = ${withheld.id}::uuid`);
    expect(await s.repo.follow(eve.id, userId, s.clock.next())).toBe(true);
    expect(await s.repo.unfollow(eve.id, userId)).toBe(true);
    const raced = await createPost(s.deps, fay.id, { body: `hello @${owner.handle}`, media: [] });
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`insert into blocks (blocker_id, blocked_id, created_at) values (${userId}::uuid, ${fay.id}::uuid, now())`);
    const gone = await createPost(s.deps, gus.id, { body: "a reply of an account deleted since", replyToId: named.id, media: [] });
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set deleted_at = now() where id = ${gus.id}::uuid`);
    // The marker and the rules, as the activity module writes them.
    const [entry] = await apiDb.execute<{ at: string }>(sql`select to_char(created_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as at from activity_items where post_id = ${shown.id}::uuid`);
    await activity.deps.repo.markSeen(userId, entry!.at);
    await activity.deps.repo.saveSettings(userId, { replies: "everyone", mentions: "older", quotes: "off", follows: true });

    const json = await read();
    expect(json.profile.sharePreviews).toBe(true);
    expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id === named.id)).toMatchObject({ mentions: [bob.handle, catHandle], countsHidden: true });
    expect(json.posts.find((post) => post.id !== named.id)).toBeUndefined();
    expect(json.activity.seenAt).toBe(entry!.at);
    expect(json.activity.settings).toEqual({ replies: "everyone", mentions: "older", quotes: "off", follows: true });
    expect(json.activity.received.map(({ kind, postId, actorHandle, shown: reason }) => ({ kind, postId, actorHandle, shown: reason }))).toEqual([
      { kind: "reply", postId: gone.id, actorHandle: gus.handle, shown: "actor_deleted" },
      { kind: "mention", postId: null, actorHandle: fay.handle, shown: "post_not_visible" },
      { kind: "follow", postId: null, actorHandle: eve.handle, shown: "unfollowed" },
      { kind: "reply", postId: null, actorHandle: dan.handle, shown: "post_not_visible" },
      { kind: "mention", postId: muted.id, actorHandle: (await s.repo.findProfiles([cat.id])).get(cat.id)!.handle, shown: "muted" },
      { kind: "reply", postId: shown.id, actorHandle: bob.handle, shown: true },
    ]);
    // Newest first, to the microsecond; read in pages of two, which the whole document matches byte for byte.
    const times = json.activity.received.map((row) => row.at);
    expect([...times].sort().reverse()).toEqual(times);
    expect(times.every((at) => /[.][0-9]{6}Z$/.test(at))).toBe(true);
    const whole = await collect(exportJson(await buildExport({ ...deps(), activity: activity.forAccount }, userId, owner.session.handle, new Date())));
    expect(JSON.parse(whole).activity).toEqual(JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(json.activity)));
    // Moderation entries are the moderation member's: none is repeated here.
    expect(json.activity.received.every((row) => ["reply", "mention", "quote", "follow"].includes(row.kind))).toBe(true);
    await migrateDb.execute(sql`delete from blocks where blocker_id = ${userId}::uuid and blocked_id = ${fay.id}::uuid`);
  });

  test("2d Task 3 (7.8, 11.2): the profile names the account's picture with its entry, which holds the 400 px square; an avatar's upload never set and a replaced picture are in neither the profile nor the archive", async () => {

import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql } from "drizzle-orm";
import pino from "pino";
import { expect } from "vitest";
import { ActivityPage, ActivitySettings, ErrorEnvelope, FlowResponse, MeResponse, PostView, type ActivityEntry } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { closeDb, createDb, type Db } from "@korbat/db";
import { createAccount } from "../../src/account";
import { createActivity } from "../../src/activity";
import { createApp } from "../../src/app";
import { createAuth } from "../../src/auth";
import { randomToken } from "../../src/auth/crypto";
import { MemoryKv } from "../../src/auth/kv";
import { loadConfig } from "../../src/config";
import { MemoryMailer } from "../../src/mail/memory";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";
import { createModeration } from "../../src/moderation";
import { createProfileStore } from "../../src/profiles/store";
import { createSocial, socialForModeration } from "../../src/social";
import { Browser } from "./http-client";
import { casesMedia, removeFixtures, rowCounts } from "./moderation-fixtures";

/** 2d's three tables (migration 0049_activity), which every activity suite leaves as it found them. */
export const ACTIVITY_TABLES = ["activity_items", "activity_state", "post_mentions"];

/** One account of a suite: its browser with a signed-in, onboarded session, its id and its handle. */
export interface Member {
  b: Browser;
  id: string;
  handle: string;
}

export interface ActivityHarnessOptions {
  /** Entries a page of Activity holds; ACTIVITY_PAGE_SIZE unless a suite lowers it to page through few entries. */
  pageSize?: number;
}

/**
 * The real app for the activity suites (2d design, section 12.3): the auth, social, moderation, account and activity
 * modules built as the server builds them, on the test database, with an in-memory limit store and mailer. `signUp`
 * makes an account over HTTP and ages its profile as only the migrator may (three days unless said, so quoting and the
 * age rule of `older` pass). Every account it made, and what hangs on it, goes with `close` (removeFixtures), so a suite
 * leaves 2d's tables as it found them; `counts` reads them for a suite's own last test.
 */
export async function activityHarness(options: ActivityHarnessOptions = {}) {
  const config = loadConfig();
  const logger = pino({ level: "silent" });
  const authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 4 });
  const apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 6 });
  const migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
  const mailer = new MemoryMailer();
  const rateLimitStore = new MemoryStore();
  const auth = createAuth({
    config,
    logger,
    authDb,
    kv: new MemoryKv(),
    mailer,
    profiles: createProfileStore(apiDb),
    turnstile: { verify: async () => true },
    breachChecker: { isBreached: async () => false },
  });
  const moderation = createModeration({ apiDb, auth: auth.forModeration, social: socialForModeration(apiDb), media: casesMedia(apiDb), requireSession: auth.requireSession, rateLimitStore, config, logger });
  const social = createSocial({ apiDb, rateLimitStore, logger, requireSession: auth.requireSession, requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(), moderation: moderation.forSocial });
  const activity = createActivity({ apiDb, social: social.forActivity, moderation: moderation.forActivity, rateLimitStore, requireSession: auth.requireSession, logger, pageSize: options.pageSize });
  const account = createAccount({
    auth: auth.forAccount,
    social: social.forAccount,
    media: { purgeOwner: async () => [], requestDeletion: async () => undefined, exportImages: async () => [], exportAvatar: async () => null },
    moderation: moderation.forAccount,
    activity: activity.forAccount,
    requireSession: auth.requireSession,
    requireFreshAuth: auth.requireFreshAuth(),
    requireStrongFreshAuth: auth.requireStrongFreshAuth(),
    rateLimitStore,
    logger,
  });
  const app = createApp({ config, logger, rateLimitStore, healthChecks: {}, auth, social, moderation, account, activity });
  const made: string[] = [];
  const before = await rowCounts(apiDb, ACTIVITY_TABLES);

  /** Sets the profile's age in hours, as only the migrator may. */
  const age = (id: string, hours: number) => migrateDb.execute(sql`update profiles set created_at = now() - make_interval(secs => ${hours * 3_600}) where id = ${id}::uuid`);

  /** A signed-in, onboarded web account, its profile `ageHours` old (three days unless said). */
  async function signUp(ageHours = 72): Promise<Member> {
    const b = new Browser(app, config.APP_ORIGIN);
    const email = `activity-${randomUUID()}@korbat.local`;
    const handle = `a${randomBytes(5).toString("hex")}`;
    const start = await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/start", { json: { email, turnstileToken: "ok", deviceId: randomToken(), platform: "web" } });
    const { flowId } = FlowResponse.parse(await start.json());
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/email/verify", { json: { flowId, code: mailer.lastCodeFor(email) } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/signup/complete", { json: { flowId, dateOfBirth: "1990-05-17", termsVersion: config.TERMS_VERSION } })).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await b.fetch("/api/auth/onboarding/handle", { json: { handle, displayName: `User ${handle}` } })).status).toBe(200);
    const id = MeResponse.parse(await (await b.fetch("/api/me")).json()).user.id;
    made.push(id);
    await age(id, ageHours);
    return { b, id, handle };
  }

  /** Posts as `m` and answers the view; `extra` names a reply's parent or a quote's post, or hides the counts. */
  async function post(m: Member, body: string, extra: { replyToId?: string; quoteOfId?: string; hideCounts?: boolean } = {}): Promise<PostView> {
    const res = await m.b.fetch("/api/posts", { json: { body, ...extra } });
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(201);
    return PostView.parse(await res.json());
  }

  /** A relation from `m` to `other` over HTTP, and its answer's status. */
  const relate = async (m: Member, other: Member, what: "follow" | "block" | "mute", on = true) => (await m.b.fetch(`/api/profiles/${other.handle}/${what}`, { method: on ? "POST" : "DELETE" })).status;

  /** One page of `m`'s Activity, checked against the contract. */
  async function page(m: Member, query: { tab?: "all" | "conversations"; cursor?: string } = {}): Promise<ActivityPage> {
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    if (query.tab) params.set("tab", query.tab);
    if (query.cursor) params.set("cursor", query.cursor);
    const res = await m.b.fetch(`/api/activity${params.size > 0 ? `?${params}` : ""}`);
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    return ActivityPage.parse(await res.json());
  }

  /** Every page of `m`'s Activity, followed cursor by cursor. */
  async function all(m: Member, tab: "all" | "conversations" = "all"): Promise<ActivityEntry[]> {
    const items: ActivityEntry[] = [];
    let cursor: string | undefined;
    for (let n = 0; n < 50; n++) {
      const got = await page(m, { tab, cursor });
      items.push(...got.items);
      if (got.nextCursor === null) return items;
      cursor = got.nextCursor;
    }
    throw new Error("Activity did not end in fifty pages");
  }

  /** What a list says, entry by entry: a post entry's kind and post, a group's day and accounts, a notice's kind and id. */
  const summary = (items: readonly ActivityEntry[]) =>
    items.map((entry) =>
      entry.type === "post" ? `${entry.kind}:${entry.post.id}` : entry.type === "follows" ? `follows:${entry.key.slice(2)}:${entry.count}:${entry.actors.map((a) => a.handle).join(",")}` : `${entry.kind}:${entry.id}`,
    );

  /** `m`'s rules, set over HTTP. */
  async function settings(m: Member, rules: Partial<ActivitySettings>): Promise<ActivitySettings> {
    const current = ActivitySettings.parse(await (await m.b.fetch("/api/activity/settings")).json());
    const res = await m.b.fetch("/api/activity/settings", { method: "PUT", json: { ...current, ...rules } });
    expect(res.status, await res.clone().text()).toBe(200);
    return ActivitySettings.parse(await res.json());
  }

  /** The error code of a refused answer. */
  const code = async (res: Response) => ErrorEnvelope.parse(await res.json()).error.code;

  /** The entries of `recipient` as stored, oldest first: kind, actor and post. */
  const stored = async (recipientId: string) =>
    (
      await migrateDb.execute<{ kind: string; actor_id: string; post_id: string | null }>(
        sql`select kind::text as kind, actor_id, post_id from activity_items where recipient_id = ${recipientId}::uuid order by created_at, id`,
      )
    ).map((row) => ({ kind: row.kind, actor: row.actor_id, post: row.post_id }));

  return {
    config,
    app,
    apiDb,
    migrateDb,
    social,
    activity,
    moderation,
    made,
    age,
    signUp,
    post,
    relate,
    page,
    all,
    summary,
    settings,
    code,
    stored,
    /** 2d's tables as they stand now. */
    counts: () => rowCounts(apiDb, ACTIVITY_TABLES),
    /** What they held before the suite's first test. */
    before,
    /** Removes every account the suite made, with what hangs on them, and closes the pools. */
    async close(): Promise<void> {
      try {
        await removeFixtures(migrateDb, made.splice(0));
      } finally {
        await Promise.all([closeDb(authDb), closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
      }
    },
    /** Removes the accounts made so far, for a suite's last test that holds the tables to what they were. */
    async removeMade(): Promise<void> {
      await removeFixtures(migrateDb, made.splice(0));
    },
  };
}

export type ActivityHarness = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof activityHarness>>;

import { randomBytes, randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { sql, type SQL } from "drizzle-orm";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import { ACTIVITY_DEFAULTS, ACTIVITY_KINDS, ACTIVITY_REACH, MEDIA_KINDS, MENTION_STORE_MAX } from "@korbat/contracts";

import { storedImageName } from "../../src/media/files";
