    expect(ended).toMatchObject({ facts: null, reason: null, measures: [], endedMeasures: [{ kind: "seal_media" }] });
  });

  test("a decision about a post its author deleted since shows korbat's copy of the text and none of its images; one whose copy was erased says on which day, and whether the post itself is still there", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const kept = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "kept by its author" });
    const gone = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "deleted by its author" });
    const goneImage = await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, gone, 0);
    const decisions: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const postId of [kept, gone]) {
      const notice = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(postId)]));
      decisions[postId] = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });
    }
    // The author deletes the second post, as the app's delete does: the row stays as a tombstone, and its image is held for the case.
    await w.apiDb.execute(sql`update posts set state = 'deleted_by_author', body = '', deleted_at = now() where id = ${gone}::uuid`);
    const deleted = await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[gone]!);
    expect(deleted.content).toEqual({ kind: "post", body: "deleted by its author", deletedByAuthor: true, images: [], imageCount: 1, imagesHidden: "deleted_by_author" });
    expect(JSON.stringify(deleted).includes(goneImage)).toBe(false);
    expect(deleted.post).toMatchObject({ id: gone });

    // The retention job's erasure, done here as the migrator does it: the content columns and the salt null, the day stamped.
    await w.migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update evidence_snapshots set body = null, media = null, display_name = null, bio = null, salt = null, erased_at = now()
                            where id in (select snapshot_id from decisions where id = any(${`{${Object.values(decisions).join(",")}}`}::uuid[]))`);
    });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[kept]!)).content).toEqual({ kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: today(), postKept: true });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[gone]!)).content).toEqual({ kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: today(), postKept: false });
    // Once an R4 redaction erased the content, every decision about the post says so, whichever is viewed.
    await w.migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      await tx.execute(sql`update decisions set redacted_at = now() where id = ${decisions[kept]!}::uuid`);
    });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[kept]!)).content).toEqual({ kind: "r4_redacted" });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, decisions[gone]!)).content).toEqual({ kind: "erased", contentErasedOn: today(), postKept: false });
  });

  test("a removal reversed in full says on which day, and leaves nothing to appeal; the correction is a decision of its own in the list", async () => {
    const author = await signUp();
    const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const notice = await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(postId)], { email: w.address() }));
    const removal = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", ground: "illegal", actions: [act("remove")] });
    expect((await decisionOf(author.b, removal)).appealUntil).not.toBeNull();
    // 3e: a removal on the ground of the law gives no strike.

    expect(await decisionOf(author.b, correction)).toMatchObject({ kind: "correction", reviewed: { kind: "final", ground: "illegal" }, reversals: [{ kind: "restore" }], appealUntil: null, reversedOn: null });

import { mediaForAccount } from "../../src/media";
import { MemoryStore } from "../../src/middleware/rate-limit";

import { eraseIntake, releaseOutcomes } from "../../src/moderation/repo";
import { reporterList } from "../../src/moderation/reports";
import { WITHOUT_MEDIA } from "../../src/social/context";
import { exportProfile } from "../../src/social/flows/export";
import { mediaHarness, type MediaHarness } from "./media-harness";
import { deciderWorld, type DeciderWorld, type RealStaff } from "./moderation-decide";
import { act, authCaseCounts, moderationCounts, newImageRow, newPostRow, saveText } from "./moderation-fixtures";
import { accountTarget, linkTarget, noticesWorld, notices, postTarget, type NoticesWorld } from "./notices-harness";
import { ageIntake } from "./retention-fixtures";
import { socialHarness, type SocialHarness } from "./social-harness";

// Every decision is confirmed with a real staff key, and each test makes several: more than a test gets by default.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 180_000 });

const HOUR = 60 * 60_000;
/** 3d (W.10): what a decision made by a person on no program's finding says of automated means, and that it has no objection. */
const NOT_AUTOMATED = { automatedDetection: false, automatedDecision: "not_automated", signal: null, objection: null } as const;

/**
 * The export's moderation member on PostgreSQL (3c design, sections 7.11, 11 and 12), through the account module's own
 * export over the real auth, social, media and moderation modules: the decisions an account was told of, as its Cases
 * screen lists them, with what each statement tells; its own reports as its list shows them, an item decided but not
 * released without its outcome; never another person's report, a reporter, a notifier or a staff member; and a post whose
 * images are sealed with its text and without those images. Every decision is confirmed with a real staff key, every
 * report goes through the intake, and outcomes are released by the database's own function. export.json is held
 * strictly equal to its parsed form. Every test commits; the file's last test removes what was stored and holds the
 * tables to what they held before it.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the export's moderation member", () => {
  let w: NoticesWorld;
  let d: DeciderWorld;
  let m: MediaHarness;
  let s: SocialHarness;
  let moderator: RealStaff;
  let admin: RealStaff;
  let origin: string;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    w = noticesWorld();
    origin = w.config.APP_ORIGIN;
    d = deciderWorld(w.apiDb, { auth: w.authForModeration, rateLimitStore: w.deps.limits });
    before = await counts();
    m = await mediaHarness(w.apiDb);
    // The social module's export over the media repository's one list for posts, as the server wires it; nothing here attaches or deletes an image.
    // 2d Task 3: no avatar is set here; WITHOUT_MEDIA's avatar members answer none.
    s = socialHarness(w.apiDb, { media: { ...WITHOUT_MEDIA, attach: async () => undefined, detachAll: async () => [], requestDeletion: async () => undefined, forPosts: (postIds) => m.deps.repo.forPosts(postIds) } });
    moderator = await d.staff("moderator");
    admin = await d.staff("admin");
  }, 120_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    m.cleanup();
    await w.close();
  });
  beforeEach(() => {
    // Past every hourly window of the limit store and the urgent alert's throttle.
    w.ahead.limitsMs += HOUR;
  });

  const counts = async (): Promise<Record<string, number>> => ({ ...(await moderationCounts(w.apiDb)), ...(await authCaseCounts(w.migrateDb)) });
  const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  // The purge's side of the three interfaces is not exercised by the export; account-deletion.test.ts covers it.
  const notHere = async (): Promise<never> => {
    throw new Error("not exercised by the export");
  };
  /** The account module's dependencies as the server composes them from the module indexes, the moderation module's among them. */
  const deps = (): AccountDeps => ({
    auth: w.auth.forAccount,
    social: { purgeProfile: notHere, exportProfile: (userId, pageSize) => exportProfile(s.deps, userId, pageSize) },
    media: { ...mediaForAccount(m.deps), purgeOwner: notHere, requestDeletion: notHere },
    moderation: w.moderation.forAccount,
    limits: new MemoryStore(),
    log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    now: () => new Date(),
  });

  /** The account's whole export as its archive holds it: the entries' names, export.json as text, and its document, which the format reads whole. */
  async function exportOf(userId: string) {
    const plan = await buildExport(deps(), userId, "the-asking-session", new Date());
    const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
    await writeExport(createZipWriter(async (chunk) => void chunks.push(Uint8Array.from(chunk))), plan);
    const files = unzipSync(Buffer.concat(chunks));
    const text = strFromU8(files["export.json"]!);
    const raw = JSON.parse(text) as Record<string, unknown>;
    const json = ExportFormat.parse(raw);
    expect(raw).toStrictEqual(json);
    // The member is followed by 3b's imports (3b Task 6, 11.2) and 2d's Activity (2d, 11.2), the document's last since.
    expect(Object.keys(raw).slice(-3)).toEqual(["moderation", "imports", "activity"]);
    return { entries: Object.keys(files).sort(), text, json };
  }

  /** A decision that committed, by its id. */
  const decided = async (staff: RealStaff, caseId: string, input: Parameters<DeciderWorld["decideAs"]>[2]) => {
    const outcome = await d.decideAs(staff, caseId, input);
    if (typeof outcome === "string") throw new Error(`the decision was not recorded: ${outcome}`);
    return outcome.decisionId;
  };
  /** A notice as its sender sent it, signed out unless a session is given, with its items and the case of its first one. */
  async function sent(request: NoticeRequest, session: Parameters<NoticesWorld["sender"]>[0] = null) {
    const answer = w.remember(await submitNotice(w.deps, request, w.sender(session)));
    await w.moderation.settle();
    const items = await w.items(answer.ref);
    return { ...answer, items, caseId: items[0]!.case_id! };
  }
  /** A report under a rule as a signed-in account sends it: no human check. */
  const report = (targets: NoticeRequest["targets"], extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => notices.rule(targets, { turnstileToken: undefined, ...extra });
  /** The daily release, by the database's one function for it: every item answered so far is shown its outcome. */
  const release = () => releaseOutcomes(w.apiDb, new Date());
  /** The statement's texts of a decision as the database holds them, read as the migrator. */
  async function textsOf(decisionId: string) {
    const [row] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ facts: string | null; reason: string | null; legal: string | null }>(
      sql`select (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.facts_digest) as facts, (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.reason_digest) as reason,
                 (select t.text from staff_texts t where t.digest = d.legal_reference_digest) as legal
            from decisions d where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid`,
    );
    return { ...row! };
  }
  /** Every member name anywhere in a value. */
  function namesIn(value: unknown, names = new Set<string>()): Set<string> {
    if (Array.isArray(value)) for (const member of value) namesIn(member, names);
    else if (value !== null && typeof value === "object") for (const [name, member] of Object.entries(value)) namesIn(member, names.add(name));
    return names;
  }

  test("the decisions an account was told of are in its export as its Cases screen lists them, newest first, with what each statement tells and where its appeal stands; a decision it was not told of is not, and nothing names who reported, what they wrote, how many did, or who decided", async () => {
    const author = await w.account();
    const reporter = await w.account();

    // A second post, reported and found fine: its author is told nothing of that decision, and the export holds nothing of it.

    await reexamineOwnItem(w.deps, reporter.id, listed.items[0]!.id, { statement: reexamined });
    await w.moderation.settle();

    expect(reopened).not.toBe(other.caseId);
    const again = await decided(moderator, reopened, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R1", actions: [act("remove")] });

    const reset = await decided(moderator, about.caseId, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R6", actions: [act("reset_bio")] });

    // Before any appeal: the four decisions the author was told of, newest first, none appealed.

    expect(told.decisions.map((entry) => entry.appeal)).toEqual([null, null, null, null]);

    const reviewed = await d.reviewAs(admin, final, { outcome: "kept" });
    if (typeof reviewed === "string") throw new Error(`the review was not recorded: ${reviewed}`);

    const exported = await exportOf(author.id);
    const [finalTexts, interimTexts, resetTexts, againTexts, reviewTexts] = [await textsOf(final), await textsOf(interim), await textsOf(reset), await textsOf(again), await textsOf(reviewed.decisionId)];
    for (const texts of [finalTexts, interimTexts, resetTexts, againTexts]) expect([typeof texts.facts, typeof texts.reason]).toEqual(["string", "string"]);
    expect(typeof reviewTexts.reason).toBe("string");
    expect(exported.json.moderation.decisions).toEqual([
      // The review: it keeps the decision, restricts nothing, and tells its own reason.
      { id: reviewed.decisionId, decidedOn: today(), postId, kind: "review", outcome: "kept", ground: null, ruleId: null, rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION, measures: [], reversals: [], facts: null, reason: reviewTexts.reason, legalReference: null, appeal: null, ...NOT_AUTOMATED },
      { id: reset, decidedOn: today(), postId: null, kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R6", rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION, measures: [{ kind: "reset_bio", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }], reversals: [], facts: resetTexts.facts, reason: resetTexts.reason, legalReference: null, appeal: null, ...NOT_AUTOMATED },
      // The removal that followed the re-examination reads like any other: nothing says what it followed.
      { id: again, decidedOn: today(), postId: fine, kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R1", rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION, measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }], reversals: [], facts: againTexts.facts, reason: againTexts.reason, legalReference: null, appeal: null, ...NOT_AUTOMATED },
      // 3e: the first removal of the author's post under a rule gives a strike; the later one (of a post made before the author was told of it) none.
      { id: final, decidedOn: today(), postId, kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R3", rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION, measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }, { kind: "strike", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }], reversals: [], facts: finalTexts.facts, reason: finalTexts.reason, legalReference: null, appeal: { state: "answered", result: "kept" }, ...NOT_AUTOMATED },
      { id: interim, decidedOn: today(), postId, kind: "interim", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R3", rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION, measures: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }], reversals: [], facts: interimTexts.facts, reason: interimTexts.reason, legalReference: null, appeal: null, ...NOT_AUTOMATED },

    expect(exported.text).not.toContain(silent);

    // Nothing of the reports, their senders or the staff: not in the member, and nowhere else in the document.
    const secrets = {
      reporterHandle: reporter.handle,
      reporterId: reporter.id,
      explanation,
      reexamined,
      firstRef: first.ref,
      otherRef: other.ref,

    // And no member of a decision's entry could carry one: its source is not even named as a category.
    expect([...namesIn(exported.json.moderation.decisions)].filter((name) => /report|intake|notice|notifier|sender|source|staff|decidedBy|handle|count|items?$/i.test(name))).toEqual([]);
    // The reporter's own export holds the reports, and no decision: none is about them.
    const theirs = (await exportOf(reporter.id)).json.moderation;
    expect(theirs.decisions).toEqual([]);
    expect(theirs.reports.map((entry) => entry.ref)).toEqual([about.ref, other.ref, first.ref]);
  });

  test("a decision that restricts nothing tells neither its facts nor its reason in the export; a reversal is listed with what it lifted, and a notice of illegality's decision with its legal reference", async () => {
    const author = await w.account();
    // Withheld while korbat decides, then found fine: the author is told that what korbat did has ended, and no more.
    const held = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const one = await sent(notices.rule([postTarget(held)], { ruleId: "R4" }));
    const withhold = await decided(moderator, one.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R4", actions: [act("withhold")] });
    const record = `the case's own record ${randomBytes(6).toString("hex")}`;

    expect((await textsOf(ended)).reason).toBe(record);
    // Removed as illegal, then reversed in full by a correction.
    const removed = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const two = await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(removed)], { email: w.address() }));
    const removal = await decided(moderator, two.caseId, { kind: "final", ground: "illegal", actions: [act("remove")] });
    const correction = await decided(moderator, two.caseId, { kind: "correction", reviewsDecisionId: removal, actions: [act("restore")] });

    const exported = await exportOf(author.id);
    const [removalTexts, correctionTexts] = [await textsOf(removal), await textsOf(correction)];

      { id: correction, decidedOn: today(), postId: removed, kind: "correction", outcome: "reversed", ground: null, ruleId: null, rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION, measures: [], reversals: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null }], facts: null, reason: correctionTexts.reason, legalReference: null, appeal: null, ...NOT_AUTOMATED },
      { id: removal, decidedOn: today(), postId: removed, kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION, measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }], reversals: [], facts: removalTexts.facts, reason: removalTexts.reason, legalReference: removalTexts.legal, appeal: null, ...NOT_AUTOMATED },
      // What the moderator wrote for the case's record is not the author's to read: the statement's data does not hold it.
      { id: ended, decidedOn: today(), postId: held, kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation", ground: null, ruleId: null, rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION, measures: [], reversals: [], facts: null, reason: null, legalReference: null, appeal: null, ...NOT_AUTOMATED },
      { id: withhold, decidedOn: today(), postId: held, kind: "interim", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R4", rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION, measures: [{ kind: "withhold", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }], reversals: [], facts: expect.any(String), reason: expect.any(String), legalReference: null, appeal: null, ...NOT_AUTOMATED },
    ]);

  });

  test("an account's own reports are in its export as its list shows them: an item decided but not released shows no outcome; released, it reads the list's words under the link the report named; a re-examination is listed; a report on the anonymous path, another person's report and a record that was erased are not", async () => {
    const reporter = await w.account();
    const other = await w.account();
    const subject = await w.account();
    const author = await w.account();
    const postId = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const quoting = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { quoteOfId: postId });
    const explanation = `my own words ${randomBytes(6).toString("hex")}`;
    const first = await sent(report([postTarget(postId), accountTarget(subject.handle)], { ruleId: "R3", explanation }), reporter.session);
    const second = await sent(notices.illegal([postTarget(quoting)], { turnstileToken: undefined, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD" }), reporter.session);
    // On the path for child sexual abuse material korbat records no sender, the account included: it is in nobody's export.
    const elsewhere = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id);
    const anonymous = await sent(notices.csam([postTarget(elsewhere)], { turnstileToken: undefined }), reporter.session);
    // Someone else reports the same post, with words of their own.
    const theirWords = `their words ${randomBytes(6).toString("hex")}`;
    const theirs = await sent(report([postTarget(postId)], { ruleId: "R3", explanation: theirWords }), other.session);

    const waiting = { reexamines: false, outcome: null, outcomeText: null, reexaminationOpen: null };
    const undecided = (await exportOf(reporter.id)).json.moderation;
    expect(undecided.decisions).toEqual([]);
    expect(undecided.reports).toEqual([
      { ref: second.ref, receivedAt: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]{12}Z$/), ground: "illegal", ruleId: null, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD", explanation: "It is a threat under section 241.", items: [{ position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${quoting}`, ...waiting }] },
      {
        ref: first.ref,
        receivedAt: expect.stringMatching(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9:.]{12}Z$/),
        ground: "rule",
        ruleId: "R3",
        category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC",
        explanation,
        items: [
          { position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${postId}`, ...waiting },
          { position: 2, link: `${origin}/u/${subject.handle}`, ...waiting },
        ],
      },
    ]);

    // Decided, and still silent: an export tells nothing before the daily release, as the list and the mail tell nothing.
    await decided(moderator, first.items[0]!.case_id!, { kind: "final", ruleId: "R3", actions: [act("remove")] });
    await decided(moderator, first.items[1]!.case_id!, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
    await decided(moderator, second.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "not_evident" });
    expect((await exportOf(reporter.id)).json.moderation.reports).toEqual(undecided.reports);
    // The account changes its handle after the report: the export keeps the handle the report named.
    const renamed = `r_${randomBytes(5).toString("hex")}`;
    await w.apiDb.execute(sql`update profiles set handle = ${renamed} where id = ${subject.id}::uuid`);
    await release();

    const released = await exportOf(reporter.id);
    const rule = getRule("R3")!;
    expect(released.json.moderation.reports.map((entry) => entry.items)).toEqual([
      [{ position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${quoting}`, reexamines: false, outcome: "not_evident", outcomeText: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_evident}. ${QUOTE_ITEM_SCOPE}`, reexaminationOpen: true }],
      [
        { position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${postId}`, reexamines: false, outcome: "restricted_rule", outcomeText: `access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R3 (${rule.title}).`, reexaminationOpen: false },
        { position: 2, link: `${origin}/u/${subject.handle}`, reexamines: false, outcome: "no_violation", outcomeText: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_violation}. ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`, reexaminationOpen: true },
      ],
    ]);
    // Item for item what the account's list of reports shows, in its order and in its words.
    const list = await reporterList(w.deps, reporter.id);
    expect(released.json.moderation.reports.map((entry) => [entry.ref, entry.receivedAt])).toEqual(list.reports.map((row) => [row.ref, row.receivedAt]));
    expect(released.json.moderation.reports.map((entry) => entry.items)).toEqual(
      list.reports.map((row) => row.items.map((item) => ({ position: item.position, link: item.link, reexamines: item.reexamines, outcome: item.outcome, outcomeText: itemOutcomeWords(item), reexaminationOpen: item.reexamination?.open ?? false }))),
    );

    // A re-examination of the account's item: the item's one request is spent, and the new item waits at its place.
    const asked = `asked again ${randomBytes(6).toString("hex")}`;
    await reexamineOwnItem(w.deps, reporter.id, list.reports[1]!.items[1]!.id, { statement: asked });
    await w.moderation.settle();
    expect((await exportOf(reporter.id)).json.moderation.reports[1]!.items).toEqual([
      { position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${postId}`, reexamines: false, outcome: "restricted_rule", outcomeText: `access restricted: it breaks korbat rule R3 (${rule.title}).`, reexaminationOpen: false },
      { position: 2, link: `${origin}/u/${subject.handle}`, reexamines: false, outcome: "no_violation", outcomeText: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.no_violation}. ${ACCOUNT_ITEM_SCOPE}`, reexaminationOpen: false },
      { position: 2, link: `${origin}/u/${subject.handle}`, reexamines: true, ...{ outcome: null, outcomeText: null, reexaminationOpen: null } },
    ]);

    // Nothing of anyone else's report, of the anonymous one, of the subject's later handle, or of the staff.
    const mine = await exportOf(reporter.id);
    const secrets = { theirRef: theirs.ref, theirWords, otherId: other.id, otherHandle: other.handle, anonymousRef: anonymous.ref, anonymousToken: anonymous.token!, renamed, moderatorId: moderator.id, moderatorHandle: moderator.handle };
    for (const [what, secret] of Object.entries(secrets)) expect(mine.text.includes(secret), what).toBe(false);
    expect([...namesIn(mine.json.moderation.reports)].filter((name) => /reporter|notifier|contact|sender|staff|decidedBy|token|hash|caseId|^id$/i.test(name))).toEqual([]);
    // 3e (W.8): the account's own count of rule reports, by the UTC day it sent them: the report under a rule counts, the
    // notice of illegality and the anonymous report do not, and nothing it sent was marked.
    const sentOn = undecided.reports[1]!.receivedAt.slice(0, 10);
    expect(mine.json.moderation.reporting).toEqual({ frameDays: STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays, days: [{ day: sentOn, reports: 1 }], marks: [], markedReports: 0 });
    // The other reporter's export holds their own report and words, and none of this account's.
    const others = await exportOf(other.id);
    expect(others.json.moderation.reports).toMatchObject([{ ref: theirs.ref, ground: "rule", ruleId: "R3", explanation: theirWords, items: [{ position: 1, link: `${origin}/post/${postId}`, outcome: "restricted_rule" }] }]);
    expect(others.text.includes(explanation)).toBe(false);
    // The author of the reported post reads the decision in theirs, and no report.
    const authors = (await exportOf(author.id)).json.moderation;
    expect(authors.reports).toEqual([]);
    expect(authors.decisions).toMatchObject([{ postId, kind: "final", outcome: "restricted", ruleId: "R3" }]);

    // A link that named nothing was answered automatically. Once korbat has erased that report's record, 30 days after
    // its outcome was shown, the record names no sender any more and the report has left the export, as it left the list.
    const nothing = await sent(report([linkTarget(`${origin}/post/${randomUUID()}`)]), reporter.session);
    await release();
    expect((await exportOf(reporter.id)).json.moderation.reports[0]).toMatchObject({ ref: nothing.ref, items: [{ position: 1, outcome: "not_available", outcomeText: `${OUTCOME_PHRASES.not_available}.`, reexaminationOpen: false }] });
    const [stored] = await w.migrateDb.execute<{ id: string }>(sql`select id from intakes where ref = ${nothing.ref}`);
    await w.migrateDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
      await tx.execute(sql`set local lock_timeout = '10s'`);
      await ageIntake(tx, stored!.id, "31 days");
    });
    expect(await eraseIntake(w.apiDb, stored!.id)).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    const after = await exportOf(reporter.id);
    expect(after.json.moderation.reports.map((entry) => entry.ref)).toEqual([second.ref, first.ref]);
    expect(after.text.includes(nothing.ref)).toBe(false);

    // The suspect item of the anonymous report is answered, so that nothing of this test keeps a post frozen.
    await decided(admin, anonymous.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
  });

  test("a post whose images are sealed is exported with its text and without those images, in the list and in the files, and the decision that sealed them is in the member; once the seal has ended the images are the account's to export again", async () => {
    const author = await w.account();
    const sealedPost = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "text beside the images" });
    const sealedImages = [await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, sealedPost, 0), await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, sealedPost, 1)];
    const plainPost = await newPostRow(w.apiDb, author.id, { body: "another post" });
    const plainImage = await newImageRow(w.apiDb, author.id, plainPost, 0);
    const notice = await sent(notices.csam([postTarget(sealedPost)]));

    // Reported, and frozen: nothing is hidden yet, and the export lists every image. None of these rows has a file in
    // this test's store, so each image the export tried to write is named under missingMedia.
    const frozen = await exportOf(author.id);
    expect(frozen.json.posts.find((post) => post.id === sealedPost)!.media.map((image) => image.id)).toEqual(sealedImages);
    expect([...frozen.json.missingMedia].sort()).toEqual([...sealedImages, plainImage].sort());
    // 3e (W.8): an account with no standing measure, no reply and no report has empty lists and counts, over the frame of its counts.
    expect(frozen.json.moderation).toEqual({ decisions: [], reports: [], strikes: [], standing: [], replies: [], reporting: { frameDays: STANDING_RULES.reportFrameDays, days: [], marks: [], markedReports: 0 }, uploads: [], releases: [] });

    const seal = await decided(moderator, notice.caseId, { kind: "interim", ruleId: "R2", actions: [act("seal_media")] });
    const sealed = await exportOf(author.id);
    // The post keeps its place, its state and its text; it names no sealed image.
    expect(sealed.json.posts.find((post) => post.id === sealedPost)).toMatchObject({ id: sealedPost, body: "text beside the images", state: "visible", media: [] });
    expect(sealed.json.posts.find((post) => post.id === plainPost)!.media).toEqual([{ id: plainImage, file: `media/${plainImage}.webp`, altText: "image 1", width: 1200, height: 800 }]);
    // No file of a sealed image is in the archive, and none was even tried: only the other post's image is missing.
    expect(sealed.entries).toEqual(["export.json"]);
    expect(sealed.json.missingMedia).toEqual([plainImage]);
    for (const image of sealedImages) expect(sealed.text.includes(image), image).toBe(false);
    // The decision that sealed them is the account's to read: a seal of the images the case reaches, under R2, with its texts.
    expect(sealed.json.moderation.decisions).toEqual([
      { id: seal, decidedOn: today(), postId: sealedPost, kind: "interim", outcome: "restricted", ground: "incompatible", ruleId: "R2", rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION, measures: [{ kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }], reversals: [], facts: expect.any(String), reason: expect.any(String), legalReference: null, appeal: null, ...NOT_AUTOMATED },
    ]);
    expect(sealed.text.includes(notice.ref)).toBe(false);

    // An admin answers without a seal: the seal ends, the images are listed again, and the author is told so.
    const answer = await decided(admin, notice.caseId, { kind: "final", outcome: "no_violation" });
    const lifted = await exportOf(author.id);
    expect(lifted.json.posts.find((post) => post.id === sealedPost)!.media.map((image) => image.id)).toEqual(sealedImages);
    expect(lifted.json.moderation.decisions.map((entry) => [entry.id, entry.kind, entry.outcome])).toEqual([
      [answer, "final", "no_violation"],
      [seal, "interim", "restricted"],
    ]);
  });

  test("this file left no row behind: the moderation tables and the four auth tables of moderation cases hold what they held before it", async () => {
    await w.cleanUp();
    await d.close();
    expect(await counts()).toEqual(before);
  });
});

// Most tests here issue dozens of statements, each a round trip, and several hold a transaction open across them: on a
// loaded machine that takes longer than the five seconds a test gets by default.
vi.setConfig({ testTimeout: 30_000 });

/** The public tables migration 0015 creates, and what the API role holds on each beside SELECT. */
const APPEND_ONLY = ["cases", "decision_actions", "appeals", "staff_texts", "evidence_snapshots", "case_access_log", "media_holds"];
const COLUMN_UPDATES: Record<string, string[]> = {

  posts: ["body", "state", "deleted_at", "like_count", "repost_count", "reply_count", "quote_count", "import_job_id", "import_source", "original_created_at", "import_shortened", "import_key", "hide_counts"],
  // 2d Task 3 (0051_avatars): profile_id, the profile an avatar is the picture of, under post_media_avatar_guard.
  post_media: ["status", "error", "post_id", "position", "width", "height", "blurhash", "alt_text", "nsfw_score", "profile_id"],
};
const READ_ONLY = ["moderation_limits", "seal_posts"];

/**
 * Migrations 0014 to 0017 (3c design, sections 6.1 to 6.3 and 6.5) against the real database: what the API role holds and
 * does not hold, which columns the database forces whatever an insert supplies, the CHECKs against the contracts'
 * constants, who owns and may call each function, and which functions alone name the freeze, write a seal's list and
 * write the moderation columns. Statements run as korbat_api, the role the running API
 * holds, unless a test says otherwise: what it cannot do is what a compromised API cannot do. Every test that writes a
 * row does it inside a transaction that is rolled back, each refused statement in a savepoint of it, so the file leaves
 * the database as it found it; its last test holds it to that.
 */
describe.skipIf(!process.env.INTEGRATION)("integration: the moderation tables, their grants and their checks", () => {
  let apiDb: Db;
  let authDb: Db;
  let migrateDb: Db;
  /** A staff account, for the one test here that needs a decision. */
  let mod: TestStaff;
  let before: Record<string, number>;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    const config = loadConfig();
    apiDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_API, { max: 4 });
    authDb = createDb(config.DATABASE_URL_AUTH, { max: 2 });
    // The migrate role is not part of the API configuration; the test environment carries it.
    migrateDb = createDb(process.env.DATABASE_URL_MIGRATE!, { max: 2 });
    mod = await newTestStaff(authDb, migrateDb, createAuthRepo(authDb), "moderator");
    before = await rowCounts(apiDb);
  }, 60_000);
  afterAll(async () => {
    await Promise.all([closeDb(apiDb), closeDb(authDb), closeDb(migrateDb)]);
  });

  /** Runs one statement as the API role, in a transaction with a lock timeout, and returns its error or null. For statements that write no row. */
  const asApi = (statement: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => pgError(withLockTimeout(apiDb, (tx) => tx.execute(statement)));
  const asAuth = (statement: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => pgError(withLockTimeout(authDb, (tx) => tx.execute(statement)));
  /** The error of one step inside a transaction, which stays usable: the step runs in a savepoint. */
  const within = (tx: DbTx, fn: (sp: DbTx) => Promise<unknown>) => pgError(tx.transaction(fn));
  const run = (tx: DbTx, statement: ReturnType<typeof sql>) => within(tx, (sp) => sp.execute(statement));
  const profile = (tx: DbTx) => newProfile(tx as unknown as Db);
  /** The digest of a salt and a text as SQL computes it, also for a salt the contracts' textDigest refuses. */
  const sqlDigest = async (db: Db | DbTx, salt: string, text: string) =>
    (await db.execute<{ digest: string }>(sql`select encode(sha256(convert_to('korbat.text.v1', 'UTF8') || decode('0a', 'hex') || decode(${salt}, 'hex') || convert_to(${text}::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex') as digest`))[0]!.digest;

  /**
   * Which of the four table privileges, TRUNCATE and MAINTAIN a role holds on a table, named as schema.table. The table is
   * found in the catalogue by its oid: looking it up by name would need USAGE on its schema, which the API role lacks on auth.
   */
  async function tablePrivileges(role: string, table: string): Promise<string[]> {
    const [schema, name] = table.split(".");
    const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ privilege: string; held: boolean }>(sql`
      select p as privilege, has_table_privilege(${role}::name, c.oid, p) as held
        from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace, unnest(array['SELECT', 'INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE', 'TRUNCATE', 'MAINTAIN']) with ordinality as u(p, place)
       where n.nspname = ${schema} and c.relname = ${name}
       order by u.place`);
    expect(rows, table).toHaveLength(6);
    return rows.filter((row) => row.held).map((row) => row.privilege);
  }

  /** The columns of a table a role may update, by a column grant or the table's. */
  async function updatableColumns(role: string, table: string): Promise<string[]> {
    const [schema, name] = table.split(".");
    const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ name: string }>(sql`
      select a.attname as name from pg_attribute a join pg_class c on c.oid = a.attrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace
       where n.nspname = ${schema} and c.relname = ${name} and a.attnum > 0 and not a.attisdropped and has_column_privilege(${role}::name, a.attrelid, a.attnum, 'UPDATE')
       order by a.attnum`);
    return rows.map((row) => row.name);
  }

  /** One CHECK as the migrated database defines it. */
  async function checkDefinition(table: string, name: string): Promise<string> {
    const [row] = await apiDb.execute<{ definition: string }>(sql`select pg_get_constraintdef(oid) as definition from pg_constraint where conrelid = ${`public.${table}`}::regclass and conname = ${name}`);
    expect(row, `${table}.${name}`).toBeDefined();
    return row!.definition;
  }

  describe("what the API role holds", () => {
    test("the append-only tables: SELECT and INSERT, and no column of them can be updated", async () => {

        expect(await tablePrivileges("korbat_api", `public.${table}`), table).toEqual(["SELECT", "INSERT"]);
        expect(await updatableColumns("korbat_api", `public.${table}`), table).toEqual([]);

      expect(await tablePrivileges("korbat_api", "public.profiles")).toEqual(["SELECT", "INSERT"]);
      expect(await updatableColumns("korbat_api", "public.profiles")).toHaveLength(11);

  describe("what the auth role holds on the new auth tables", () => {

  describe("the functions and who names them", () => {
    type Fn = { name: string; args: string; owner: string; definer: boolean; config: string[] | null; api: boolean; auth: boolean; pub: boolean; definition: string };
    /** Every function of the public and auth schemas with its definition, as the catalogue holds it. */
    const functions = () =>
      apiDb.execute<Fn>(sql`
        select p.pronamespace::regnamespace::text || '.' || p.proname as name, pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid) as args, p.proowner::regrole::text as owner,
               p.prosecdef as definer, p.proconfig as config, has_function_privilege('korbat_api', p.oid, 'execute') as api,
               has_function_privilege('korbat_auth', p.oid, 'execute') as auth, has_function_privilege('public', p.oid, 'execute') as pub,
               pg_get_functiondef(p.oid) as definition
          from pg_proc p
         where p.pronamespace in ('public'::regnamespace, 'auth'::regnamespace) and p.prokind = 'f'
         order by 1`);

    /** Every other definition the database holds that could name a function: views, triggers, constraints, index predicates and policies. */
    const otherDefinitions = () =>
      apiDb.execute<{ kind: string; name: string; definition: string }>(sql`
        select 'view' as kind, c.relname::text as name, pg_get_viewdef(c.oid) as definition from pg_class c where c.relkind = 'v' and c.relnamespace in ('public'::regnamespace, 'auth'::regnamespace)
        union all select 'trigger', t.tgname::text, pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) from pg_trigger t join pg_class c on c.oid = t.tgrelid where not t.tgisinternal and c.relnamespace in ('public'::regnamespace, 'auth'::regnamespace)
        union all select 'constraint', n.conname::text, pg_get_constraintdef(n.oid) from pg_constraint n where n.connamespace in ('public'::regnamespace, 'auth'::regnamespace)
        union all select 'index', i.indexrelid::regclass::text, pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid) from pg_index i join pg_class c on c.oid = i.indrelid where c.relnamespace in ('public'::regnamespace, 'auth'::regnamespace)
        union all select 'policy', p.polname::text, coalesce(pg_get_expr(p.polqual, p.polrelid), '') || ' ' || coalesce(pg_get_expr(p.polwithcheck, p.polrelid), '') from pg_policy p`);

    test("the migrator owns every function of 0015, each with its search path pinned and EXECUTE taken from PUBLIC", async () => {
      const pub = ["search_path=public, pg_temp"];
      // [definer, EXECUTE for the API role]. The few a role calls directly are granted to that role alone; a trigger
      // function fires for every role all the same, and nobody calls it.
      const expected: Record<string, [boolean, boolean]> = {
        appeal_deadline: [false, true],
        case_access_log_insert: [false, false],
        cases_insert: [false, false],
        evidence_snapshots_insert: [false, false],
        frozen_for: [false, true],
        intake_items_attach: [true, false],
        intake_items_quote: [true, false],
        intakes_insert: [false, false],
        media_holds_apply: [true, false],
        media_holds_insert: [false, false],
        post_frozen: [false, true],
        post_media_guard: [false, false],
        post_media_insert: [false, false],
        post_media_keep: [true, false],
        staff_texts_insert: [false, false],
      };
      const names = Object.keys(expected);
      const rows = (await functions()).filter((f) => f.name.startsWith("public.") && names.includes(f.name.slice(7)));
      expect(rows.map((f) => f.name.slice(7)).sort()).toEqual([...names].sort());
      for (const f of rows) {
        const [definer, api] = expected[f.name.slice(7)]!;
        expect({ name: f.name, owner: f.owner, definer: f.definer, config: f.config, api: f.api, auth: f.auth, pub: f.pub }).toEqual({ name: f.name, owner: "korbat_migrate", definer, config: pub, api, auth: false, pub: false });
      }
    });

    test("the migrator owns every function of 0016; the API role may call four of them and no other", async () => {
      const pub = ["search_path=public, pg_temp"];
      // [definer, EXECUTE for the API role, the pinned search path]. The trigger functions fire for every role and nobody

      }

      }

      expect(authSide.map((f) => ({ name: f.name, owner: f.owner, definer: f.definer, config: f.config, api: f.api, auth: f.auth, pub: f.pub }))).toEqual([
        { name: "auth.staff_link_counts", owner: "korbat_migrate", definer: true, config: auth, api: false, auth: true, pub: false },
        { name: "auth.users_deleted_mark", owner: "korbat_migrate", definer: false, config: auth, api: false, auth: false, pub: false },
      ]);
      // Everything the API role may call of what the migrator owns, in both schemas, after the last migration of 3c (design,

      // and 3e's two steps of the retention job (0024_standing_retention): a reply's text and the reporting counts; and 3f's

      expect(callable).toEqual([

    test("frozen_for is named only by post_frozen and by the keep trigger's function; post_frozen only by decisions_record, erase_snapshots, redact_r4_body and order_preservation_end", async () => {
      const all = await functions();
      const naming = (word: RegExp) => all.filter((f) => word.test(f.definition)).map((f) => f.name);
      // Each function's own definition holds its name.
      expect(naming(/\bfrozen_for\b/)).toEqual(["public.frozen_for", "public.post_frozen", "public.post_media_keep"]);
      // One function of 0016 reads the freeze: the one that stores whether a decision was taken while nobody could open the images.
      // And two of 0018: the one function that erases a snapshot (gate E), and the R4 redaction, which waits while its post is frozen.
      // And (3f, 0029) the end of an order's preservation, which waits as the redaction does.
      expect(naming(/\bpost_frozen\b/)).toEqual(["public.decisions_record", "public.erase_snapshots", "public.order_preservation_end", "public.post_frozen", "public.redact_r4_body"]);
      // Nor does a view, a trigger, a constraint, an index or a policy name either.
      const others = (await otherDefinitions()).filter((d) => /\b(frozen_for|post_frozen)\b/.test(d.definition));
      expect(others.map((d) => `${d.kind} ${d.name}`)).toEqual([]);
    });

    test("one function writes a seal's list, and one the moderation columns of posts and images", async () => {
      const all = await functions();
      const matching = (statement: RegExp) => all.filter((f) => statement.test(f.definition)).map((f) => f.name);
      // A statement that writes the table, as SQL may spell it: an insert, an update, a delete or a merge, the name bare or
      // schema-qualified, quoted or not; for a column, an update, a merge or an insert that updates on a conflict.
      const sealList = /(insert\s+into|update|delete\s+from|merge\s+into)\s+(only\s+)?("?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?seal_posts"?(?![\w"])/i;
      const imageState = /(update\s+(only\s+)?|merge\s+into\s+(only\s+)?|insert\s+into\s+)("?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?post_media"?(?![\w"])[^;]*\bset\b[^;]*"?moderation_state"?\s*=/i;
      const postColumns = /(update\s+(only\s+)?|merge\s+into\s+(only\s+)?|insert\s+into\s+)("?public"?\s*\.\s*)?"?posts"?(?![\w"])[^;]*\bset\b[^;]*"?(moderation_level|state|erased_at)"?\s*=/i;
      const calls = /\bmoderation_apply\s*\(/i;
      expect(matching(sealList)).toEqual(["public.decision_actions_apply"]);
      expect(matching(imageState)).toEqual(["public.moderation_apply"]);
      // Of the three columns of posts, the level and the state are moderation_apply's alone; the erasure mark is the R4
      // redaction's and (3f, 0029) the end of an order's preservation's.
      expect(matching(postColumns)).toEqual(["public.moderation_apply", "public.order_preservation_end", "public.redact_r4_body"]);
      const written = (table: string, columns: string) =>
        new RegExp(String.raw`(update\s+(only\s+)?|merge\s+into\s+(only\s+)?|insert\s+into\s+)("?public"?\s*[.]\s*)?"?${table}"?(?![\w"])[^;]*\bset\b[^;]*"?(${columns})"?\s*=`, "i");
      const postLevel = written("posts", "moderation_level|state");
      const postErased = written("posts", "erased_at");
      const imageErased = written("post_media", "erased_at");
      const snapshotErased = written("evidence_snapshots", "erased_at");
      expect(matching(postLevel)).toEqual(["public.moderation_apply"]);
      expect(matching(postErased)).toEqual(["public.order_preservation_end", "public.redact_r4_body"]);
      // 3d Task 2 (0034_release; C 17, extended): a release and its replay erase the image rows of their posts.
      // 3d Task 7 (0039_known_material): and a held upload's release, its replay, and the replay of a lost end as no_report.
      expect(matching(imageErased)).toEqual([
        "public.order_preservation_end",
        "public.redact_r4_body",
        "public.release_replay",
        "public.seal_release",
        "public.upload_hold_replay",
        "public.upload_release",
        "public.upload_release_replay",
      ]);
      // Gate E: one function writes a snapshot's erasure, no function deletes a snapshot, and that one function is called
      // by the two erasures of 0018 and by nothing else.
      expect(matching(snapshotErased)).toEqual(["public.erase_snapshots"]);
      expect(matching(/delete\s+from\s+(only\s+)?("?public"?\s*[.]\s*)?"?evidence_snapshots"?(?![\w"])/i)).toEqual([]);
      expect(matching(/\berase_snapshots\s*\(/i)).toEqual(["public.erase_case_evidence", "public.erase_snapshots", "public.order_preservation_end", "public.redact_r4_body"]);
      // The writer is called by the two triggers that follow a stored decision and a stored measure, by the R4 redaction,
      // and (3f) by order_correct, whose changed withholding derives the level of its measures' posts again.
      // And (3f, 0029) the end of an order's preservation, by which an erased post is removed for good.
      expect(matching(calls)).toEqual(["public.decision_actions_apply", "public.decisions_apply", "public.moderation_apply", "public.order_correct", "public.order_preservation_end", "public.redact_r4_body"]);
      for (const statement of [
        "UPDATE public.evidence_snapshots s SET erased_at = now(), body = NULL",
        'update only "public"."evidence_snapshots" set "erased_at" = $1',
        "merge into evidence_snapshots s using v on s.id = v.id when matched then update set erased_at = now()",
      ]) {
        expect(snapshotErased.test(statement), statement).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(snapshotErased.test("select 1 from public.evidence_snapshots s where s.erased_at is null; update public.staff_texts t set erased_at = now()")).toBe(false);
      expect(imageErased.test("UPDATE public.post_media m SET erased_at = coalesce(m.erased_at, now())")).toBe(true);
      expect(imageErased.test("UPDATE public.media_holds h SET released_at = now(); select m.erased_at = now() from public.post_media m")).toBe(false);
      expect(postErased.test("UPDATE public.posts p SET body = '', erased_at = now()")).toBe(true);
      expect(postErased.test("UPDATE public.posts p SET moderation_level = v.level WHERE p.erased_at IS NOT NULL")).toBe(false);
      // Each search finds such a statement in every form, and no other statement.
      for (const statement of [
        "INSERT INTO public.seal_posts (action_id, post_id, images)",
        'insert into "public"."seal_posts" (action_id)',
        "update seal_posts s set images = 1",
        'DELETE FROM ONLY "seal_posts" s',
        "merge into public.seal_posts s using listed l on l.post_id = s.post_id",
      ]) {
        expect(sealList.test(statement), statement).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(sealList.test("select 1 from public.seal_posts s; delete from public.seal_posts_kept")).toBe(false);
      for (const statement of [
        "UPDATE public.post_media i SET status = 'ready', moderation_state = v.state",
        'update only "public"."post_media" set "moderation_state" = $1',
        "insert into post_media (id) values ($1) on conflict (id) do update set moderation_state = excluded.moderation_state",
        "merge into public.post_media m using v on m.id = v.id when matched then update set moderation_state = v.state",
      ]) {
        expect(imageState.test(statement), statement).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(imageState.test("UPDATE public.post_media m SET hold_until = latest WHERE m.id = NEW.media_id; SELECT moderation_state = 'x'")).toBe(false);
      expect(imageState.test("insert into public.post_media (owner_id, moderation_state) values ($1, 'visible')")).toBe(false);
      for (const statement of [
        "update posts set body = '', state = 'removed'",
        'UPDATE "public"."posts" p SET "moderation_level" = v.level',
        "insert into public.posts (id) values ($1) on conflict (id) do update set erased_at = now()",
        "merge into posts p using v on p.id = v.id when matched then update set state = v.state",
      ]) {
        expect(postColumns.test(statement), statement).toBe(true);
      }
      expect(postColumns.test("insert into public.posts (author_id, body, state) values ($1, $2, 'visible')")).toBe(false);
      expect(postColumns.test("update public.posts_archive set state = 'removed'")).toBe(false);
    });

    test("the triggers of 0015 are on their tables, in the timing the design gives", async () => {
      const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ name: string; definition: string }>(sql`

               'public.evidence_snapshots'::regclass, 'public.case_access_log'::regclass, 'public.post_media'::regclass, 'public.media_holds'::regclass)
         order by 1`);

        media_holds_insert: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.media_holds FOR EACH ROW",

        // fires before post_media_refused.
        post_media_avatar_guard: "BEFORE UPDATE OF profile_id ON public.post_media FOR EACH ROW",
        post_media_guard: 'BEFORE UPDATE OF post_id, owner_id, alt_text, "position", width, height, blurhash ON public.post_media FOR EACH ROW',
        // 3b (0044_imported_posts): an imported image is attached only to its own import's post; it is inserted only with a
        // preparing job of its owner, and a native one names no job. By name, the import's insert check runs first.
        post_media_import_attach: "BEFORE UPDATE OF post_id ON public.post_media FOR EACH ROW",
        post_media_import_insert: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.post_media FOR EACH ROW",
        post_media_insert: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.post_media FOR EACH ROW",
        post_media_keep: "BEFORE DELETE ON public.post_media FOR EACH ROW",
        // 3d review M12 (0041_review): an image that stops being sealed weighs its lost files' notices again.
        post_media_lost_told: "AFTER UPDATE OF moderation_state ON public.post_media FOR EACH ROW",
        // 3d Task 7 (0039_known_material): a refused upload is attached to no post, whatever the API sends. 2d Task 3: nor set
        // as an avatar.
        post_media_refused: "BEFORE UPDATE OF post_id, profile_id ON public.post_media FOR EACH ROW",
        // 3d Task 3 (0035_edge_purges): the edge's outbox row of an image that stops being public, after the statement. 2d
        // Task 3: and of an avatar that is detached.
        post_media_purge: "AFTER DELETE OR UPDATE OF moderation_state, erased_at, profile_id ON public.post_media FOR EACH ROW",
        // 3e's reporting counts (0022_reporting_counts) add the tally of each report after it is stored, on the same table.
        report_tallies_count: "AFTER INSERT ON public.intakes FOR EACH ROW",
        staff_texts_insert: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.staff_texts FOR EACH ROW",
      });
    });

      const rows = await apiDb.execute<{ name: string; definition: string }>(sql`
        select t.tgname::text as name, pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid) as definition from pg_trigger t
         where not t.tgisinternal and t.tgrelid in ('public.posts'::regclass, 'public.decisions'::regclass, 'public.decision_actions'::regclass)
         order by 1`);
      const timing = Object.fromEntries(rows.map((row) => [row.name, row.definition.replace(/^CREATE (CONSTRAINT )?TRIGGER \S+ /, "").replace(/ EXECUTE FUNCTION .*$/, "")]));
      expect(timing).toEqual({
        decision_actions_apply: "AFTER INSERT ON public.decision_actions FOR EACH ROW",
        decision_actions_check: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.decision_actions FOR EACH ROW",
        // The decision's check at commit, queued again by every row of its ledger.
        decision_actions_recheck: "AFTER INSERT ON public.decision_actions DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW",
        // 3f Task 5 (0030_authority_records): a seal opens its record to the authorities, after decision_actions_apply.
        decision_actions_report: "AFTER INSERT ON public.decision_actions FOR EACH ROW",
        decisions_apply: "AFTER INSERT ON public.decisions FOR EACH ROW",
        decisions_check: "AFTER INSERT ON public.decisions DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW",
        // 3e: a statement mail's outcome moves one way, and fixes the start of an announced measure.
        decisions_mail_forward: "BEFORE UPDATE OF author_mail, author_mail_at ON public.decisions FOR EACH ROW",
        decisions_mail_standing: expect.stringMatching(/^AFTER UPDATE OF author_mail ON public[.]decisions FOR EACH ROW WHEN /),
        decisions_record: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.decisions FOR EACH ROW",
        posts_guard_insert: "BEFORE INSERT ON public.posts FOR EACH ROW",
        // Only a statement that names one of the three columns and changes one meets the guard: a counter's update never does.
        posts_guard_update: expect.stringMatching(/^BEFORE UPDATE OF state, moderation_level, erased_at ON public\.posts FOR EACH ROW WHEN \(.*IS DISTINCT FROM.*IS DISTINCT FROM.*IS DISTINCT FROM.*\)$/),
        // 3b (0044_imported_posts): only a statement that names one of the five import columns meets the import's guard, so
        // a counter's update (every like) never does; by name it runs after posts_guard_insert.
        posts_import_guard: "BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF import_job_id, import_source, original_created_at, import_shortened, import_key ON public.posts FOR EACH ROW",
        // 2d Task 1 (0049_activity): a post whose erased_at becomes set loses its stored mentions.
        post_mentions_erase: "AFTER UPDATE OF erased_at ON public.posts FOR EACH ROW",
        // 3d Task 3 (0035_edge_purges): one outbox row for each image of a post whose level or state leaves visible.
        posts_purge: "AFTER UPDATE OF moderation_level, state ON public.posts FOR EACH ROW",
      });
    });

    test("the case's history runs with its reader's rights, and the API role only reads it", async () => {

      expect(view!.options).toEqual(["security_invoker=true"]);
