```tsx
import { cloneElement, type ReactElement } from "react";
import { renderToStaticMarkup } from "react-dom/server";
import { describe, expect, test, vi } from "vitest";
import type { PostView } from "@korbat/contracts";
import { RichText } from "../src/components/social/RichText";
import { PostCard, QuoteEmbed } from "../src/components/social/PostCard";

/**
 * A post's words (3b design, sections 5.3, 10.6 and decision 21; Task 7): mentions are links in a native post and never in
 * an imported one, whose @names belong to another platform, even where an account of that name exists on korbat; and
 * every link to an outside page is marked nofollow and ugc, opens without a reference back and sends no referrer.
 */
vi.mock("expo-router", () => ({
  Link: ({ href, children }: { href: string; children: ReactElement }) => cloneElement(children, { href } as object),
  router: { push: () => undefined, replace: () => undefined },
}));
vi.mock("@/lib/session", () => ({ useSession: () => ({ state: { status: "signed-out" }, refresh: async () => undefined }) }));
vi.mock("expo-image", async () => {
  const { createElement } = await import("react");
  return { Image: ({ source, accessibilityLabel }: { source: { uri: string }; accessibilityLabel: string }) => createElement("img", { "data-uri": source.uri, alt: accessibilityLabel }) };
});
vi.mock("@/components/toast", () => ({ toast: { show: vi.fn() }, Toaster: () => null }));

const html = (element: ReactElement): string => renderToStaticMarkup(element);
const anchors = (markup: string): string[] => markup.match(/<a\b[^>]*>/g) ?? [];
const hrefOf = (tag: string): string => /href="([^"]+)"/.exec(tag)?.[1] ?? "";
const REL = "nofollow ugc noopener noreferrer";

const id = (n: number) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;
// An account @ada exists on korbat: the author of this card.
const ADA = { id: id(1), handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada Lovelace", verified: false, avatar: null };
const BODY = "Thanks @ada and @grace_h, notes at https://example.org/notes and http://example.com/x";

function post(extra: Partial<PostView> = {}): PostView {
  return {
    id: id(10),
    author: { id: id(2), handle: "grace", displayName: "Grace Hopper", verified: false, avatar: null },
    body: BODY,
    createdAt: "2026-10-21T10:00:00.000Z",
    state: "visible",
    replyTo: null,
    counts: { likes: 0, reposts: 0, replies: 0, quotes: 0 },
    media: [],
    quoteOf: null,
    imported: null,
    mentions: [],
    countsHidden: false,
    ...extra,
  };
}

describe("RichText", () => {
  test("in a native post a mention is a link to the profile, and every outside link carries rel nofollow ugc noopener noreferrer", () => {
    const out = html(<RichText body={BODY} />);
    const links = anchors(out);
    expect(links.map(hrefOf)).toEqual(["/u/ada", "/u/grace_h", "https://example.org/notes", "http://example.com/x"]);
    for (const tag of links.filter((link) => hrefOf(link).startsWith("http"))) {
      expect(tag).toContain(`rel="${REL}"`);
      expect(tag).toContain('target="_blank"');
    }
  });

  test("with mentions off, @ada stays text, while an account @ada exists, and the outside links keep their rel", () => {
    const out = html(<RichText body={BODY} mentions={false} />);
    expect(anchors(out).map(hrefOf)).toEqual(["https://example.org/notes", "http://example.com/x"]);
    expect(out).toContain("@ada");
    for (const tag of anchors(out)) expect(tag).toContain(`rel="${REL}"`);
  });

  test("an imported post's card draws its body with mentions off: no /u/ada link but the author's own", () => {
    const imported = post({ author: ADA, imported: { source: "x", at: "2019-03-03", shortened: false } });
    const out = html(<PostCard post={imported} />);
    // The author line links Ada's profile once, the avatar's hidden link once: the body's @ada links nothing.
    expect(anchors(out).filter((tag) => hrefOf(tag) === "/u/ada")).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(anchors(out).filter((tag) => hrefOf(tag) === "/u/grace_h")).toEqual([]);
    const native = html(<PostCard post={post({ author: ADA })} />);
    expect(anchors(native).filter((tag) => hrefOf(tag) === "/u/ada")).toHaveLength(3);
  });

  test("a quoted imported post shows the short label and no mention as a link", () => {
    const quoted = { ...post({ id: id(11), imported: { source: "mastodon", at: "2019-03-03", shortened: true } }), quoteOf: null };
    const out = html(<QuoteEmbed quote={quoted} />);
    expect(out).toContain("Imported from Mastodon");
    expect(out).not.toContain("dated");
    // Quoted words are plain text: no mention, no link but the quote's own (its author and its time).
    expect(anchors(out).map(hrefOf)).toEqual(["/u/grace", `/post/${id(11)}`]);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { mkdtempSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { tmpdir } from "node:os";
import path from "node:path";
import { crc32 } from "node:zlib";
import sharp from "sharp";

/** Images the tests make themselves, so the repository carries no binary fixtures. Encoders are never blocked; only loaders are. */

const flat = (width: number, height: number, channels: 3 | 4 = 3) =>
  sharp({ create: { width, height, channels, background: channels === 4 ? { r: 200, g: 30, b: 30, alpha: 0.5 } : { r: 200, g: 30, b: 30 } } });

export const SECRET = "secret-owner-of-this-photo";

/** A JPEG stored sideways (EXIF orientation 6), with a copyright string, GPS position and a Display P3 profile. */
export const photoWithMetadata = () =>
  flat(400, 200)
    .jpeg()
    .withExif({ IFD0: { Copyright: SECRET }, IFD3: { GPSLatitudeRef: "N", GPSLatitude: "51/1 30/1 0/1", GPSLongitudeRef: "W", GPSLongitude: "0/1 7/1 0/1" } })
    .withIccProfile("p3")
    .withMetadata({ orientation: 6 })
    .toBuffer();

export const jpeg = (width = 400, height = 200) => flat(width, height).jpeg().toBuffer();
export const png = (width = 400, height = 200) => flat(width, height, 4).png().toBuffer();
export const webp = (width = 400, height = 200) => flat(width, height, 4).webp().toBuffer();
export const gif = (width = 400, height = 200) => flat(width, height).gif().toBuffer();
export const avif = (width = 400, height = 200) => flat(width, height).avif({ effort: 0 }).toBuffer();
export const tiff = () => flat(40, 20).tiff().toBuffer();
export const svg = () => Buffer.from('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="10" height="10"><rect width="10" height="10"/></svg>');

/** Two 20 by 20 frames stacked in one strip, which is how libvips holds an animation. */
const strip = () => {
  const data = Buffer.alloc(20 * 40 * 3, 0);
  data.fill(255, 20 * 20 * 3);
  return sharp(data, { raw: { width: 20, height: 40, channels: 3, pageHeight: 20 } });
};
export const animatedGif = () => strip().gif({ delay: [100, 100], loop: 0 }).toBuffer();
export const animatedWebp = () => strip().webp({ delay: [100, 100], loop: 0 }).toBuffer();

/** An ordinary PNG with an `acTL` chunk after its header, which is what makes a PNG animated. */
export async function animatedPng(): Promise<Buffer> {
  const still = await png(20, 20);
  const body = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from("acTL"), Buffer.from([0, 0, 0, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0])]);
  const chunk = Buffer.alloc(16 + 4);
  chunk.writeUInt32BE(8, 0);
  body.copy(chunk, 4);
  chunk.writeUInt32BE(crc32(body), 16);
  const afterHeader = 8 + 25;
  return Buffer.concat([still.subarray(0, afterHeader), chunk, still.subarray(afterHeader)]);
}

/**
 * 2d Task 3 (design, section 12.1): an image of three flat colour bands along its longer side, red, green and blue, the
 * first ending at 5/12 of the side and the second at 7/12, so that the centre of each crop's square falls in a band of its
 * own: on a side of 300 and a square of 200, the start's centre is at 100 (red), the centre's at 150 (green) and the end's
 * at 200 (blue). Each band is a solid run of pixels, so a crop's position is read back from its square's centre pixel.
 */
export const BANDS = { red: [220, 40, 40], green: [40, 200, 40], blue: [40, 40, 220] } as const;
export function banded(width: number, height: number) {
  const long = Math.max(width, height);
  const pixels = Buffer.alloc(width * height * 3);
  for (let y = 0; y < height; y++) {
    for (let x = 0; x < width; x++) {
      const along = width >= height ? x : y;
      const band = along < (long * 5) / 12 ? BANDS.red : along < (long * 7) / 12 ? BANDS.green : BANDS.blue;
      pixels.set(band, (y * width + x) * 3);
    }
  }
  return sharp(pixels, { raw: { width, height, channels: 3 } });
}

/** Which band a WebP's centre pixel shows: the channel that stands out, read through the lossy encoding. */
export async function centreBand(webp: Buffer): Promise<"red" | "green" | "blue"> {
  const { data, info } = await sharp(webp).removeAlpha().raw().toBuffer({ resolveWithObject: true });
  const at = (Math.floor(info.height / 2) * info.width + Math.floor(info.width / 2)) * info.channels;
  const [r, g, b] = [data[at]!, data[at + 1]!, data[at + 2]!];
  return r >= g && r >= b ? "red" : g >= b ? "green" : "blue";
}

/** The first box of an HEIC file. The sniffer refuses it before a decoder sees the rest. */
export const heicHeader = () => Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([0, 0, 0, 24]), Buffer.from("ftypheic"), Buffer.from([0, 0, 0, 0]), Buffer.from("mif1heic"), Buffer.alloc(64)]);

/** A temporary directory with helpers to put fixtures on disk, where the pipeline reads them. */
export function workspace() {
  const dir = mkdtempSync(path.join(tmpdir(), "korbat-worker-"));
  return {
    dir,
    file(name: string, data: Buffer): string {
      const target = path.join(dir, name);
      writeFileSync(target, data);
      return target;
    },
    remove: () => rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true }),
  };
}
```

```ts
import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

import path from "node:path";
import pino from "pino";
import { afterAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import { Heartbeat, MEDIA_FORMATS, ResultFile, storeLayout, uploadsLayout } from "@korbat/media-protocol";
import { prepareStore, tick, writeHeartbeat, type LoopDeps } from "../src/loop";

const READY: Processed = { ok: true, width: 800, height: 600, blurhash: "L2Eo_P_3jb_3", small: Buffer.from("small-bytes"), large: Buffer.from("large-bytes") };

/** Two fresh volumes and a loop around a stand-in pipeline, so these tests are about the protocol only. */
async function harness(process: LoopDeps["process"] = async () => READY) {
  const root = path.join(ws.dir, randomUUID());
  const uploads = uploadsLayout(path.join(root, "uploads"));
  const store = storeLayout(path.join(root, "store"));
  for (const dir of [uploads.tmp, uploads.incoming, uploads.deletions]) mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  await prepareStore(store);
  const calls: string[] = [];
  // 2d Task 3: the crop each call was given, undefined for a post's upload.
  const crops: (string | undefined)[] = [];
  const aborted: string[] = [];
  let clock = 1_800_000_000_000;
  const deps: LoopDeps = {
    uploads,
    store,
    formats: MEDIA_FORMATS,
    log: pino({ level: "silent" }),
    now: () => (clock += 5),
    process: async (file, formats, avatar) => {
      calls.push(path.basename(file));
      crops.push(avatar?.crop);
      return process(file, formats, avatar);
    },
    abort: (reason) => void aborted.push(reason),
    watchdogMs: 10_000,
  };
  const upload = (data: Buffer | string = "bytes", id: string = randomUUID()) => {
    writeFileSync(uploads.upload(id), data);
    return id;
  };
  const result = (id: string) => ResultFile.parse(JSON.parse(readFileSync(store.result(id), "utf8")));
  /** 2d Task 3: an avatar's job file beside the upload, as the API writes it before the upload. */
  const job = (id: string, text: string) => writeFileSync(uploads.avatarJob(id), text);
  return { deps, uploads, store, upload, job, result, calls, crops, aborted };
}
```

```ts
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import sharp from "sharp";
import { MEDIA_FORMATS, R1_MARKER, R1_TEST_MODEL } from "@korbat/media-protocol";
import { configureDecoder, processImage, type Processed } from "../src/pipeline";
import { testScorer } from "../src/score";
import * as make from "./fixtures";

const ws = make.workspace();
const run = async (name: string, data: Buffer): Promise<Processed> => processImage(ws.file(name, data), MEDIA_FORMATS);
const ready = (result: Processed) => {
  if (!result.ok) throw new Error(`expected a processed image, got ${result.reason}`);
  return result;
};

beforeAll(() => configureDecoder(MEDIA_FORMATS));
afterAll(() => ws.remove());

describe("the decoder allowlist", () => {
  test("every enabled format decodes, so no loader class name is misspelled", async () => {
    for (const [name, data] of Object.entries({ jpeg: await make.jpeg(), png: await make.png(), webp: await make.webp(), gif: await make.gif(), avif: await make.avif() })) {
      expect((await sharp(data).metadata()).width, name).toBe(400);
    }
  });

  test("the decoder itself refuses SVG and TIFF, which the prebuilt binary could otherwise read", async () => {
    await expect(sharp(make.svg()).metadata()).rejects.toThrow(/unsupported image format/);
    await expect(sharp(await make.tiff()).metadata()).rejects.toThrow(/unsupported image format/);
  });
});

describe("accepted images", () => {
  test.each(["jpeg", "png", "webp", "gif", "avif"] as const)("%s becomes two WebP files and a blurhash, never enlarged", async (format) => {
    const result = ready(await run(`in.${format}`, await make[format]()));
    expect([result.width, result.height]).toEqual([400, 200]);
    expect(result.blurhash).toMatch(/^[0-9A-Za-z#$%*+,\-.:;=?@[\]^_{|}~]{6,}$/);
    for (const data of [result.large, result.small]) {
      expect(data.subarray(0, 4).toString("latin1")).toBe("RIFF");
      expect(data.subarray(8, 12).toString("latin1")).toBe("WEBP");
      expect(await sharp(data).metadata()).toMatchObject({ format: "webp", width: 400, height: 200 });
    }
  });

  test("a large image is reduced to 2048 and 1024 on its longer side, and the result reports the large size", async () => {
    const result = ready(await run("big.jpg", await make.jpeg(3000, 1500)));
    expect([result.width, result.height]).toEqual([2048, 1024]);
    expect(await sharp(result.large).metadata()).toMatchObject({ width: 2048, height: 1024 });
    expect(await sharp(result.small).metadata()).toMatchObject({ width: 1024, height: 512 });
  });

  test("transparency survives", async () => {
    const result = ready(await run("alpha.png", await make.png()));
    expect((await sharp(result.large).metadata()).hasAlpha).toBe(true);
  });

  test("the EXIF rotation is applied, and nothing of the original's metadata survives", async () => {
    const original = await make.photoWithMetadata();
    const before = await sharp(original).metadata();
    expect(before.orientation).toBe(6);
    expect(original.includes(make.SECRET)).toBe(true);
    expect(before.icc).toBeDefined();

    const result = ready(await run("sideways.jpg", original));
    expect([result.width, result.height]).toEqual([200, 400]);
    for (const data of [result.large, result.small]) {
      const meta = await sharp(data).metadata();
      expect([meta.exif, meta.icc, meta.xmp, meta.iptc, meta.orientation]).toEqual([undefined, undefined, undefined, undefined, undefined]);
      expect(data.includes(make.SECRET)).toBe(false);
      expect(data.includes("GPS")).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  test("bytes appended to an image do not reach the output", async () => {
    const marker = "PK\u0003\u0004 hidden-archive-payload";
    const result = ready(await run("polyglot.jpg", Buffer.concat([await make.jpeg(), Buffer.from(marker, "latin1")])));
    expect(result.large.includes("hidden-archive-payload")).toBe(false);
    expect(result.small.includes("hidden-archive-payload")).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("3d Task 6: the R1 scorer through the real pipeline (design, sections 5 and 12)", () => {
  /** An image of the given format, of one colour, with or without the marker's block in its top left corner. */
  async function withMarker(format: "png" | "jpeg" | "webp", width: number, height: number, marked: boolean): Promise<Buffer> {
    const base = sharp({ create: { width, height, channels: 3, background: { r: 30, g: 120, b: 60 } } });
    const block = await sharp({ create: { width: R1_MARKER.side, height: R1_MARKER.side, channels: 3, background: { r: R1_MARKER.red, g: R1_MARKER.green, b: R1_MARKER.blue } } }).png().toBuffer();
    const image = marked ? base.composite([{ input: block, left: 0, top: 0 }]) : base;
    return format === "png" ? image.png().toBuffer() : format === "jpeg" ? image.jpeg({ quality: 90 }).toBuffer() : image.webp({ quality: 90 }).toBuffer();
  }

  test("the marker survives the decode, the resize to the small size and the conversion to sRGB, as PNG, JPEG and WebP", async () => {
    for (const format of ["png", "jpeg", "webp"] as const) {
      // 1600 pixels wide: the small size halves it, so the marker's block reaches the scorer at half its side.
      const marked = ready(await processImage(ws.file(`marked.${format}`, await withMarker(format, 1600, 900, true)), MEDIA_FORMATS, testScorer));
      expect(marked.r1, format).toEqual({ model: R1_TEST_MODEL, score: 1 });
      const plain = ready(await processImage(ws.file(`plain.${format}`, await withMarker(format, 1600, 900, false)), MEDIA_FORMATS, testScorer));
      expect(plain.r1, format).toEqual({ model: R1_TEST_MODEL, score: 0 });
    }
  });

  test("without a scorer nothing is scored: the result carries no r1", async () => {
    const result = ready(await processImage(ws.file("unscored.png", await withMarker("png", 400, 300, true)), MEDIA_FORMATS));
    expect(result.r1).toBeUndefined();
  });

  test("a scorer is handed the small size's raw pixels and their shape, and nothing else", async () => {
    const seen: { length: number; width: number; height: number; channels: number }[] = [];
    const recording = { model: "recording", score: async (pixels: Uint8Array, width: number, height: number, channels: number) => (seen.push({ length: pixels.length, width, height, channels }), 0.25) };
    const result = ready(await processImage(ws.file("seen.png", await withMarker("png", 1600, 900, false)), MEDIA_FORMATS, recording));
    expect(result.r1).toEqual({ model: "recording", score: 0.25 });
    expect(seen).toEqual([{ length: 1024 * 576 * 3, width: 1024, height: 576, channels: 3 }]);
  });
});

describe("2d Task 3: an avatar's two squares (design, sections 7.1 and 7.4)", () => {
  type Crop = "start" | "centre" | "end";
  const avatar = async (name: string, data: Buffer, crop: Crop, scorer: Parameters<typeof processImage>[2] = null) => ready(await processImage(ws.file(name, data), MEDIA_FORMATS, scorer, { crop }));
  const size = async (data: Buffer) => {
    const meta = await sharp(data).metadata();
    return [meta.width, meta.height];
  };

  test("each crop takes its square along the longer side, on a landscape and a portrait source: start, centre (rounded down) and end", async () => {
    for (const [name, width, height] of [["landscape", 300, 200], ["portrait", 200, 300]] as const) {
      const source = await make.banded(width, height).png().toBuffer();
      const bands: string[] = [];
      for (const crop of ["start", "centre", "end"] as const) {
        const result = await avatar(`${name}-${crop}.png`, source, crop);
        // The square's side is the shorter side, 200, under the large square's 400: never enlarged.
        expect([result.width, result.height], `${name} ${crop}`).toEqual([200, 200]);
        expect(await size(result.large), `${name} ${crop}`).toEqual([200, 200]);
        expect(await size(result.small), `${name} ${crop}`).toEqual([128, 128]);
        expect(await make.centreBand(result.small), `${name} ${crop} small`).toBe(await make.centreBand(result.large));
        bands.push(await make.centreBand(result.large));
      }
      expect(bands, name).toEqual(["red", "green", "blue"]);
    }
  });

  test("a large source becomes a 400 square and a 128 square, and the result reports the large one", async () => {
    const result = await avatar("big.jpg", await make.jpeg(1200, 900), "centre");
    expect([result.width, result.height]).toEqual([400, 400]);
    expect(await size(result.large)).toEqual([400, 400]);
    expect(await size(result.small)).toEqual([128, 128]);
    for (const data of [result.large, result.small]) expect(data.subarray(8, 12).toString("latin1")).toBe("WEBP");
    expect(result.blurhash.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(6);
  });

  test("a source smaller than both squares is never enlarged: both files are its shorter side's square", async () => {
    const result = await avatar("small.png", await make.png(90, 60), "end");
    expect([result.width, result.height]).toEqual([60, 60]);
    expect(await size(result.large)).toEqual([60, 60]);
    expect(await size(result.small)).toEqual([60, 60]);
  });

  test("the EXIF rotation is applied before the crop: the start of an image stored sideways is the top of the image as shown", async () => {
    // Stored 300 by 200, red on the left and blue on the right, with orientation 8: shown turned a quarter anticlockwise,
    // 200 by 300, with the stored right edge (blue) on top. A crop along the stored width would start in red.
    const sideways = await make.banded(300, 200).jpeg({ quality: 95 }).withMetadata({ orientation: 8 }).toBuffer();
    expect((await sharp(sideways).metadata()).orientation).toBe(8);
    const start = await avatar("sideways-start.jpg", sideways, "start");
    expect([start.width, start.height]).toEqual([200, 200]);
    expect(await make.centreBand(start.large)).toBe("blue");
    expect(await make.centreBand((await avatar("sideways-end.jpg", sideways, "end")).large)).toBe("red");
  });

  test("both squares are fresh encodes: nothing of the source's EXIF, GPS, ICC or XMP survives", async () => {
    const original = await make.photoWithMetadata();
    expect(original.includes(make.SECRET)).toBe(true);
    const result = await avatar("private.jpg", original, "centre");
    for (const data of [result.large, result.small]) {
      const meta = await sharp(data).metadata();
      expect([meta.exif, meta.icc, meta.xmp, meta.iptc, meta.orientation]).toEqual([undefined, undefined, undefined, undefined, undefined]);
      expect(data.includes(make.SECRET)).toBe(false);
      expect(data.includes("GPS")).toBe(false);
    }
  });

  test("a scorer is handed the 400 square's raw pixels and their shape, as a post's image hands it its small size's", async () => {
    const seen: { length: number; width: number; height: number; channels: number }[] = [];
    const recording = { model: "recording", score: async (pixels: Uint8Array, width: number, height: number, channels: number) => (seen.push({ length: pixels.length, width, height, channels }), 0.75) };
    const result = await avatar("scored.png", await make.banded(1600, 900).png().toBuffer(), "centre", recording);
    expect(result.r1).toEqual({ model: "recording", score: 0.75 });
    expect(seen).toEqual([{ length: 400 * 400 * 3, width: 400, height: 400, channels: 3 }]);
  });

  test("an avatar's refusals are a post's: the format, the animation and the pixel caps are checked first", async () => {
    expect(await processImage(ws.file("avatar.svg", make.svg()), MEDIA_FORMATS, null, { crop: "centre" })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "unsupported_format" });
    expect(await processImage(ws.file("avatar-anim.gif", await make.animatedGif()), MEDIA_FORMATS, null, { crop: "centre" })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "animated_not_supported" });
    expect(await processImage(ws.file("avatar-huge.png", await make.png(8500, 6000)), MEDIA_FORMATS, null, { crop: "centre" })).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "image_too_large" });
  });
});

describe("refused files", () => {
  test("anything that is not an enabled image format is refused by its first bytes", async () => {
    expect(await run("drawing.svg", make.svg())).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "unsupported_format" });
    expect(await run("scan.tiff", await make.tiff())).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "unsupported_format" });
    expect(await run("photo.heic", make.heicHeader())).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "unsupported_format" });
    expect(await run("notes.txt", Buffer.from("just text"))).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "unsupported_format" });
    expect(await run("empty", Buffer.alloc(0))).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "unsupported_format" });
  });

  test("animation is refused: GIF by its page count, WebP by its header, PNG by its acTL chunk", async () => {
    expect(await run("anim.gif", await make.animatedGif())).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "animated_not_supported" });
    expect(await run("anim.webp", await make.animatedWebp())).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "animated_not_supported" });
    expect(await run("anim.png", await make.animatedPng())).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "animated_not_supported" });
  });

  test("a truncated file and a file that only starts like an image are corrupt", async () => {
    const whole = await sharp({ create: { width: 800, height: 800, channels: 3, background: "#336699", noise: { type: "gaussian", mean: 128, sigma: 50 } } }).jpeg().toBuffer();
    expect(await run("cut.jpg", whole.subarray(0, Math.floor(whole.length * 0.6)))).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "corrupt_image" });
    expect(await run("fake.png", Buffer.concat([Buffer.from([0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a]), Buffer.from("not really a png")]))).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "corrupt_image" });
  });

  test("the pixel caps hold: 51 megapixels of PNG, 17 of AVIF, and a side of 16,384", async () => {
    expect(await run("huge.png", await make.png(8500, 6000))).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "image_too_large" });
    expect(await run("huge.avif", await make.avif(4250, 4000))).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "image_too_large" });
    expect(await run("wide.png", await make.png(16_384, 4))).toEqual({ ok: false, reason: "image_too_large" });
  });

  test("an AVIF of 12 megapixels and a 16,383 pixel panorama are fine", async () => {
    expect(ready(await run("ok.avif", await make.avif(4000, 3000))).width).toBe(2048);
    expect(ready(await run("panorama.png", await make.png(16_383, 40))).width).toBe(2048);
  });

  test("a missing file is an error, not a verdict about the image", async () => {
    await expect(processImage(`${ws.dir}/absent.jpg`, MEDIA_FORMATS)).rejects.toThrow();
  });
});
```

```ts
    expect(ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, avatar } }).profile.avatar).toEqual(avatar);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, avatar: undefined } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, avatar: { ...avatar, width: 0 } } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, avatar: { id: media, file: avatar.file } } }).success).toBe(false);
    const [post] = full.posts;
    const withPost = (over: Record<string, unknown>) => ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, posts: [{ ...post, ...over }] }).success;
    expect(withPost({ mentions: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withPost({ countsHidden: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withPost({ mentions: [1] })).toBe(false);
    expect(Object.keys(ExportFormat.shape.activity.shape)).toEqual(["seenAt", "settings", "received"]);
    const withActivity = (over: Record<string, unknown>) => ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, activity: { ...full.activity, ...over } }).success;
    expect(withActivity({ seenAt: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withActivity({ settings: { ...full.activity.settings, replies: "friends" } })).toBe(false);
    expect(withActivity({ received: undefined })).toBe(false);
    const [reply, muted, , unfollowed] = full.activity.received;
    const withEntry = (entry: unknown) => withActivity({ received: [entry] });
    // Each reason, and true; never false, and never a reason the export does not name.
    for (const shown of [true, "muted", "unfollowed", "actor_deleted"]) expect(withEntry({ ...muted, shown }), String(shown)).toBe(true);
    expect(withEntry({ ...reply, shown: false })).toBe(false);
    expect(withEntry({ ...reply, shown: "blocked" })).toBe(false);
    // A post the account may not see is named by no id, and a follow names none.
    expect(withEntry({ ...reply, shown: "post_not_visible" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withEntry({ ...reply, shown: "post_not_visible", postId: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withEntry({ ...unfollowed, postId: reply!.postId })).toBe(false);
    expect(withEntry({ ...reply, kind: "like" })).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, activity: undefined }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the format name is fixed, so a reader can tell what it opened", () => {
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, format: "korbat-export-2" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, format: undefined }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the account and the profile carry the nullable facts as null, never missing", () => {
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, account: { ...full.account, termsVersion: null, termsAcceptedAt: null } }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, account: { ...full.account, email: "not-an-email" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, account: { ...full.account, role: "owner" } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, handleHistory: undefined } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, handleHistory: [1] } }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the profile carries the author's Explore switch, always, as it stands", () => {
    // Part of the format since 2c, beside the handle history: on as well as off, never left out.
    expect(ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, showInExplore: true } }).profile.showInExplore).toBe(true);
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).profile.showInExplore).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, showInExplore: undefined } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, showInExplore: "off" } }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the profile lists the account's own handles that korbat retired, each with when, beside the handle history (3e design, W.8)", () => {
    // Added to korbat-export-1 last in the profile, as the Explore switch was: always there, empty when nothing is retired.
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).profile.retiredHandles).toEqual([{ handle: "ada_l", retiredAt: at }]);
    expect(ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, retiredHandles: [] } }).profile.retiredHandles).toEqual([]);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, retiredHandles: undefined } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, retiredHandles: [{ handle: "ada_l", retiredAt: null }] } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, profile: { ...full.profile, retiredHandles: [{ handle: "ada_l" }] } }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the account's passkeys carry a name, their times, whether they are synced and where they were added, and nothing that identifies the key", () => {
    const [laptop] = full.account.passkeys;
    const withPasskeys = (passkeys: unknown) => ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, account: { ...full.account, passkeys } }).success;
    // The list is part of the format since 1c: always present, empty for an account without passkeys.
    expect(withPasskeys(undefined)).toBe(false);
    expect(withPasskeys([])).toBe(true);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, lastUsedAt: null, createdOn: null }])).toBe(true);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, lastUsedAt: undefined }])).toBe(false);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, createdOn: undefined }])).toBe(false);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, name: undefined }])).toBe(false);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, createdAt: "last week" }])).toBe(false);
    expect(withPasskeys([{ ...laptop, synced: "yes" }])).toBe(false);
    // A reader gets the five fields and no more: nothing of the key, its id or its authenticator is part of the format.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, account: { ...full.account, passkeys: [{ ...laptop, id: id(7), credentialId: "Y3JlZA", publicKey: "cose", aaguid: id(8) }] } });
    expect(parsed.account.passkeys).toEqual([laptop]);
  });

  test("a deleted post keeps its place with an empty body and a deletion time; an attached image has its dimensions", () => {
    const [post] = full.posts;
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, posts: [{ ...post, state: "hidden" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, posts: [{ ...post, replyToId: undefined }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, posts: [{ ...post, media: [{ id: id(3), file: "media/x.webp", altText: "a cat" }] }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, posts: [{ ...post, media: undefined }] }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("engagement entries name a post and a time, graph entries a handle and a time", () => {
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, likes: [{ postId: "nope", at }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, bookmarks: [{ postId: id(5) }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, following: [{ handle: "grace" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, mutes: [{ handle: "loud", since: "last week" }] }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("sessions, devices, events and missing media keep their shapes", () => {
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, sessions: [{ id: id(9), createdAt: at, lastUsedAt: at }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, devices: [{ ...full.devices[0], label: null }] }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, devices: [{ ...full.devices[0], platform: "desktop" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, events: [{ type: "signup" }] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, missingMedia: undefined }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("the export's moderation member", () => {
  const [decision, correction] = full.moderation.decisions;
  const [report] = full.moderation.reports;
  const [released, waiting] = report!.items;
  const withModeration = (moderation: unknown) => ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, moderation }).success;
  const withDecision = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ decisions: [{ ...decision, ...change }], reports: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING });
  const withReport = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [{ ...report, ...change }], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING });
  const withItem = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withReport({ items: [{ ...released, ...change }] });

  test("is part of korbat-export-1 since 3c, the last member of the document until 3b's imports: always present, with its two lists, either of which may be empty", () => {
    // Added without a new format name, as the passkeys and the Explore switch were: a reader that skips it loses nothing.
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).format).toBe("korbat-export-1");
    // 3b (11.2): the account's imports come after it, and 2d's Activity after them (the pin moved with 2d).
    expect(Object.keys(ExportFormat.shape).at(-3)).toBe("moderation");
    expect(withModeration(undefined)).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ reports: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [] })).toBe(false);
    // 3e: the strikes, the standing measures, the replies and the reporting counts are always there too.
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [], strikes: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [], strikes: [], standing: [], replies: [] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING })).toBe(true);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [decision], reports: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING })).toBe(true);
    expect(withModeration({ decisions: [], reports: [report], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING })).toBe(true);
  });

  test("a decision carries its day, the post it concerns, its kind, outcome, ground, rule and rules version, its measures with whether each changed anything, its reversals, the texts still held and where the appeal stands", () => {
    expect(withDecision({})).toBe(true);
    // The day, never the time: the list of decisions shows a day too.
    expect(withDecision({ decidedOn: at })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ decidedOn: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // A decision about the account names no post; the member is null then, never missing.
    expect(withDecision({ postId: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ postId: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ postId: "the-post" })).toBe(false);
    // 3f (W.7): an order's decision is an entry like any other once its author was told.
    for (const kind of ["interim", "final", "order", "review", "correction"]) expect(withDecision({ kind }), kind).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ kind: "appeal" })).toBe(false);
    for (const outcome of ["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident", "kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]) expect(withDecision({ outcome }), outcome).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ outcome: "suspended" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ ground: "illegal", ruleId: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ ground: "other" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ ruleId: "R7" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ rulesVersion: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ rulesVersion: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // The fourteen measures (3c's seven, 3e's six and 3f's order measure) and nothing else; a reversal is no measure, and a measure no reversal.
    for (const kind of MEASURE_KINDS) expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind, mediaId: null, noEffect: null }] }), kind).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "restore", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "overrule", mediaId: null, noEffect: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind: "strike", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind: "overrule", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(true);
    for (const noEffect of ["already", "deleted", null]) expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect }] }), String(noEffect)).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null, noEffect: "no" }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(false);
    for (const kind of ["restore", "unseal_media", "restore_media", "restore_display_name", "restore_bio"]) expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind, mediaId: null }] }), kind).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: [{ kind: "remove", mediaId: null }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ measures: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ reversals: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // A text that is not held, or that the decision never had, is null, never missing.
    expect(withDecision({ facts: null, reason: null, legalReference: null })).toBe(true);
    for (const text of ["facts", "reason", "legalReference"]) expect(withDecision({ [text]: undefined }), text).toBe(false);
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).moderation.decisions[1]).toEqual(correction);
  });

  test("an appeal is pending without a result or answered with one, and null when none was filed", () => {
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "pending", result: null } })).toBe(true);
    for (const result of ["kept", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]) expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "answered", result } }), result).toBe(true);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "pending", result: "kept" } })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "answered", result: null } })).toBe(false);
    expect(withDecision({ appeal: { state: "withdrawn", result: null } })).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a decision is read with its own members and no more: nothing of who reported, who decided or how many reports there were is part of the format", () => {
    const extra = { ...decision, decidedBy: id(20), staffHandle: "mod_one", reporterId: id(21), reporterHandle: "grace", reports: 3, source: "report", caseId: id(22) };
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { decisions: [extra], reports: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.decisions).toEqual([decision]);
  });

  test("a report carries its reference, when korbat received it, its ground with the rule it cited, its category and its sender's own explanation while that is held", () => {
    expect(withReport({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withReport({ ref: "N-abc" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ receivedAt: "last week" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ ground: "rule", ruleId: "R6", category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC" })).toBe(true);
    // A report on the path for child sexual abuse material records no sender, so it is in nobody's export.
    expect(withReport({ ground: "csam" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ ruleId: "R9" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ ruleId: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_MADE_UP" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ explanation: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReport({ explanation: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ items: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // Read with its own members and no more.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { decisions: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING, reports: [{ ...report, reporterId: id(1), contactId: id(23), lookupHash: "f".repeat(64), token: "secret" }] } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.reports).toEqual([report]);
  });

  test("an item carries its place in the report, its link and whether it is a re-examination; its outcome, the outcome's words and whether a re-examination is open come together, with the release, or not at all", () => {
    expect(withItem({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withReport({ items: [waiting] })).toBe(true);
    expect(withItem({ position: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ position: 21 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ link: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ reexamines: undefined })).toBe(false);
    for (const outcome of ["restricted_rule", "restricted_legal", "no_violation", "not_evident", "not_available", "partly_reversed", "reversed"]) expect(withItem({ outcome }), outcome).toBe(true);
    expect(withItem({ outcome: "restricted" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ reexaminationOpen: false })).toBe(true);
    // Released, all three are told; before the release, none is.
    expect(withItem({ outcome: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ outcomeText: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withItem({ reexaminationOpen: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ items: [{ ...waiting, reexaminationOpen: false }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReport({ items: [{ ...waiting, outcomeText: "no action" }] })).toBe(false);
    // An item is read with its own members and no more: the list's id of an item is not part of the export.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { decisions: [], strikes: [], ...NO_STANDING, reports: [{ ...report, items: [{ ...released, id: id(24), caseId: id(25), answeredBy: id(26) }] }] } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.reports[0]!.items).toEqual([released]);
  });
});

describe("the moderation member's standing, replies and reporting (3e design, W.8)", () => {
  const [suspension, warning] = full.moderation.standing;
  const [answered] = full.moderation.replies;
  const [counting, withdrawn] = full.moderation.reporting.marks;
  const withModeration = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => ExportFormat.safeParse({ ...full, moderation: { ...full.moderation, ...change } }).success;
  const withStanding = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ standing: [{ ...suspension, ...change }] });
  const withReply = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ replies: [{ ...answered, ...change }] });
  const withReporting = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withModeration({ reporting: { ...full.moderation.reporting, ...change } });
  const withMark = (change: Record<string, unknown>) => withReporting({ marks: [{ ...counting, ...change }] });

  test("come after the strikes, in this order, and every one of them is always there", () => {
    // 3d (W.10): the refused uploads and the releases come last.
    expect(Object.keys(ExportFormat.shape.moderation.shape)).toEqual(["decisions", "reports", "strikes", "standing", "replies", "reporting", "uploads", "releases"]);
    expect(ExportFormat.parse(full).moderation).toEqual(full.moderation);
    for (const member of ["standing", "replies", "reporting"]) expect(withModeration({ [member]: undefined }), member).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a standing entry is a suspension, a termination, a warning or a restriction of reporting, with its basis, days, times, lift and broken basis", () => {
    expect(withStanding({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withModeration({ standing: [warning] })).toBe(true);
    for (const kind of ["suspend", "terminate", "warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting"]) expect(withStanding({ kind }), kind).toBe(true);
    // A strike is in strikes, a retirement in the profile's retired handles; neither is a standing entry.
    for (const kind of ["strike", "retire_handle", "remove"]) expect(withStanding({ kind }), kind).toBe(false);
    for (const basis of ["strikes", "threat", "terrorist", "flood", "protective", "threat_repeat", "ladder_end", "reports"]) expect(withStanding({ basis }), basis).toBe(true);
    expect(withStanding({ basis: "other" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withStanding({ days: null, kind: "terminate" })).toBe(true);
    expect(withStanding({ days: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withStanding({ days: 31 })).toBe(false);
    // A period that never started, or a termination without end, has no start or no end.
    expect(withStanding({ startsAt: null, endsAt: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withStanding({ basisEndedAt: at, basisEndedBy: id(33) })).toBe(true);
    expect(withStanding({ replaced: null })).toBe(false);
    expect(withStanding({ liftedBy: "a staff member" })).toBe(false);
    // An entry is read with its own members and no more: who decided is not part of it.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { ...full.moderation, standing: [{ ...suspension, decidedBy: id(40), handle: "staff" }] } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.standing).toEqual([suspension]);
  });

  test("a reply carries when it was filed, whether it was on time, its text while korbat holds it, when that was erased and its answer", () => {
    expect(withReply({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withReply({ text: null, erasedAt: at })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReply({ text: null, erasedAt: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReply({ answeredAt: null, answeredBy: null })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReply({ text: "x".repeat(2001) })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReply({ onTime: undefined })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReply({ filedAt: "yesterday" })).toBe(false);
  });

  test("the reporting counts carry the frame, the reports of each day, each mark by its own report's reference and position, and the marked reports a threshold reads", () => {
    expect(withReporting({})).toBe(true);
    expect(withModeration({ reporting: { frameDays: 90, days: [], marks: [], markedReports: 0 } })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReporting({ marks: [withdrawn] })).toBe(true);
    expect(withReporting({ frameDays: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReporting({ markedReports: -1 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReporting({ days: [{ day: at, reports: 1 }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withReporting({ days: [{ day: "2026-09-24", reports: 0 }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(withMark({ ref: "not a reference" })).toBe(false);
    expect(withMark({ position: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(withMark({ sentOn: at })).toBe(false);
    expect(withMark({ counts: undefined })).toBe(false);
    // A mark names the account's own report and nothing else: never the item, the decision or who was reported.
    const parsed = ExportFormat.parse({ ...full, moderation: { ...full.moderation, reporting: { ...full.moderation.reporting, marks: [{ ...counting, itemId: id(41), decisionId: id(42), target: "u/bob" }] } } });
    expect(parsed.moderation.reporting.marks).toEqual([counting]);
  });
});
```

```ts
    expect(ActivitySettings.parse({ replies: "older", mentions: "following", quotes: "off", follows: false })).toEqual({ replies: "older", mentions: "following", quotes: "off", follows: false });
    expect(ACTIVITY_DEFAULTS).toEqual({ replies: "everyone", mentions: "everyone", quotes: "everyone", follows: true });
    expect(ActivitySettings.parse(ACTIVITY_DEFAULTS)).toEqual(ACTIVITY_DEFAULTS);
  });

  test("refuses a reach outside the list, a follow switch that is not a boolean, and a missing member", () => {
    expect(ActivitySettings.safeParse({ ...ACTIVITY_DEFAULTS, replies: "friends" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ActivitySettings.safeParse({ ...ACTIVITY_DEFAULTS, follows: "everyone" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ActivitySettings.safeParse({ replies: "everyone", mentions: "everyone", quotes: "everyone" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("ActivityTime: the database's microseconds, in UTC", () => {
  test("six fractional digits and Z, and nothing else", () => {
    expect(ActivityTime.safeParse(AT).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ActivityTime.safeParse("2026-10-27T10:00:00.123Z").success).toBe(false);
    expect(ActivityTime.safeParse("2026-10-27T10:00:00Z").success).toBe(false);
    expect(ActivityTime.safeParse("2026-10-27T10:00:00.123456+01:00").success).toBe(false);
    expect(ActivityTime.safeParse("2026-10-27 10:00:00.123456Z").success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("ActivityEntry", () => {
  test("a post entry: reply, mention or quote, its own key, the post's view", () => {
    for (const kind of ["reply", "mention", "quote"]) expect(ok(postEntry({ kind })), kind).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(postEntry({ kind: "follow" }))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(postEntry({ key: `d:${id(9)}` }))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(postEntry({ key: "f:2026-10-27" }))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(postEntry({ at: "2026-10-27T10:00:00.123Z" }))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(postEntry({ new: "yes" }))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(postEntry({ post: { ...post, state: "deleted_by_author" } }))).toBe(false);
    const parsed = ActivityEntry.parse(postEntry());
    expect(parsed.type === "post" && parsed.post.id).toBe(id(50));
  });

  test("a follows entry: the day's key, its newest follow's time in that day, the count and at most three actors", () => {
    expect(ok(followsEntry())).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(followsEntry({ count: 1, actors: [author(1)] }))).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(followsEntry({ actors: [author(1), author(2), author(3), author(4)] }))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(followsEntry({ actors: [] }))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(followsEntry({ count: 2, actors: [author(1), author(2), author(3)] }))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(followsEntry({ count: 0, actors: [] }))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(followsEntry({ key: "f:2026-10-26" }))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(followsEntry({ key: `e:${id(9)}` }))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(followsEntry({ key: "f:2026-02-30", at: "2026-02-30T10:00:00.123456Z" }))).toBe(false);
  });

  test("a moderation entry: its kind's key over its id, its target, and the post's id and time exactly when the target is a post", () => {
    expect(ok(moderationEntry())).toBe(true);
    for (const [kind, prefix] of [
      ["decision", "d"],
      ["release", "r"],
      ["upload", "u"],
      ["lost", "l"],
    ]) {
      expect(ok(moderationEntry({ kind, key: `${prefix}:${id(7)}` })), kind).toBe(true);
      expect(ok(moderationEntry({ kind, key: `${prefix}:${id(8)}` })), `${kind} with another id`).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(ok(moderationEntry({ kind: "release", key: `d:${id(7)}` }))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(moderationEntry({ kind: "strike" }))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(moderationEntry({ target: "profile", postId: null, postCreatedAt: null }))).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(moderationEntry({ target: "account", postId: null, postCreatedAt: null }))).toBe(true);
    expect(ok(moderationEntry({ target: "profile" }))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(moderationEntry({ postId: null, postCreatedAt: null }))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(moderationEntry({ postCreatedAt: null }))).toBe(false);
    expect(ok(moderationEntry({ target: "image" }))).toBe(false);
  });

  test("an unknown type is refused", () => {
    expect(ok({ ...postEntry(), type: "like" })).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("ActivityPage, the queries and the seen marker", () => {
  test("a page holds at most ACTIVITY_PAGE_SIZE entries, the next cursor and the stored marker, null before the first visit", () => {
    const items = [postEntry(), followsEntry(), moderationEntry()];
    expect(ActivityPage.safeParse({ items, nextCursor: null, seenAt: null }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ActivityPage.safeParse({ items, nextCursor: encodeActivityCursor({ at: AT, key: `e:${id(9)}` }), seenAt: AT }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ActivityPage.safeParse({ items: Array.from({ length: ACTIVITY_PAGE_SIZE + 1 }, () => postEntry()), nextCursor: null, seenAt: null }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ActivityPage.safeParse({ items, nextCursor: null, seenAt: "2026-10-27T10:00:00.123Z" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ActivityPage.safeParse({ items, nextCursor: "not a cursor!", seenAt: null }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("ActivityQuery: the tab, All by default, and an optional cursor word", () => {
    expect(ActivityQuery.parse({})).toEqual({ tab: "all" });
    expect(ActivityQuery.parse({ tab: "conversations", cursor: "abc_DEF-1" })).toEqual({ tab: "conversations", cursor: "abc_DEF-1" });
    expect(ActivityQuery.safeParse({ tab: "mentions" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ActivityQuery.safeParse({ cursor: "" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ActivityQuery.safeParse({ cursor: "a".repeat(401) }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("ActivityNewerQuery: the tab and the newest time shown, absent when the screen shows none; the count from 0 to 21", () => {
    expect(ActivityNewerQuery.parse({ since: AT })).toEqual({ tab: "all", since: AT });
    expect(ActivityNewerQuery.parse({ tab: "conversations" })).toEqual({ tab: "conversations" });
    expect(ActivityNewerQuery.safeParse({ since: "2026-10-27T10:00:00.123Z" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ActivityNewerResponse.safeParse({ count: 0 }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ActivityNewerResponse.safeParse({ count: ACTIVITY_NEWER_CAP }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ActivityNewerResponse.safeParse({ count: ACTIVITY_NEWER_CAP + 1 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ActivityNewerResponse.safeParse({ count: -1 }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("SeenRequest: an entry's own time, to the microsecond, so that the marker never stops short of the newest entry", () => {
    expect(SeenRequest.parse({ at: AT })).toEqual({ at: AT });
    expect(SeenRequest.safeParse({ at: "2026-10-27T10:00:00.123Z" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SeenRequest.safeParse({}).success).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("the cursor on (at, key)", () => {
  const places = [
    { at: AT, key: `e:${id(9)}` },
    { at: "2026-10-27T23:59:59.999999Z", key: "f:2026-10-27" },
    { at: "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000000Z", key: `d:${id(1)}` },
    { at: AT, key: `r:${id(2)}` },
    { at: AT, key: `u:${id(3)}` },
    { at: AT, key: `l:${id(4)}` },
  ];

  test("round trip: each key of each source, the time kept to the microsecond", () => {
    for (const place of places) {
      const word = encodeActivityCursor(place);
      expect(word, place.key).toMatch(/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,400}$/);
      expect(decodeActivityCursor(word), place.key).toEqual(place);
      expect(ActivityQuery.safeParse({ cursor: word }).success, place.key).toBe(true);
    }
    // Two places a microsecond apart are two cursors.
    expect(encodeActivityCursor({ at: "2026-10-27T10:00:00.123456Z", key: `e:${id(9)}` })).not.toBe(encodeActivityCursor({ at: "2026-10-27T10:00:00.123457Z", key: `e:${id(9)}` }));
  });

  test("the encoder refuses what is not a place: a millisecond time, an unknown key, an upper-case id", () => {
    expect(() => encodeActivityCursor({ at: "2026-10-27T10:00:00.123Z", key: `e:${id(9)}` })).toThrow();
    expect(() => encodeActivityCursor({ at: AT, key: `x:${id(9)}` })).toThrow();
    expect(() => encodeActivityCursor({ at: AT, key: "e:3F2A9C1E-8B7D-4E6F-A5C4-0123456789AB" })).toThrow();
    expect(encodeActivityCursor({ at: AT, key: "e:3f2a9c1e-8b7d-4e6f-a5c4-0123456789ab" })).toMatch(/_e_3f2a9c1e/);
    expect(() => encodeActivityCursor({ at: AT, key: "f:2026-13-01" })).toThrow();
  });

  test("the decoder refuses anything it did not write, never guessing", () => {
    const word = encodeActivityCursor({ at: AT, key: `e:${id(9)}` });
    for (const forged of [
      "",
      "abc",
      `${word}x`,
      `x${word}`,
      word.toUpperCase(),
      word.replace("_e_", "_x_"),
      word.replace("_e_", "_f_"),
      // A time that is no time: the 30th of February, the 25th hour.
      encodeActivityCursor({ at: AT, key: `e:${id(9)}` }).replace(/^2026102710/, "2026023010"),
      encodeActivityCursor({ at: AT, key: `e:${id(9)}` }).replace(/^2026102710/, "2026102725"),
      encodeActivityCursor({ at: AT, key: "f:2026-10-27" }).replace("2026-10-27", "2026-02-30"),
      // Another module's cursor: base64url of JSON.
      "WyIyMDI2LTEwLTI3VDEwOjAwOjAwLjEyMzQ1NloiLCIwMDAwMDAwMC0wMDAwLTQwMDAtODAwMC0wMDAwMDAwMDAwMDkiXQ",
    ]) {
      expect(decodeActivityCursor(forged), forged).toBeNull();
    }
  });
});
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import {
  AuthErrorCode,
  BadgeStartRequest,
  BadgeVerifyRequest,
  BadgeVerifyResponse,

  DeleteStartResponse,

  Phone,
  ReauthRequest,
  ReauthResponse,
  RecoveryCode,
  SessionInfo,
  SessionsResponse,
  SignupCompleteRequest,
  TotpDisableRequest,
} from "../src/index";

const flow = "a".repeat(43);
const userId = "3f1c2b1e-8d4a-4c1e-9b2a-6f0e5d4c3b2a";

/** A minimal well-formed authentication assertion, for the passkey re-authentication variant. */
const reauthAssertion = {
  id: "q2Xx0w8bRk6nV8yQ0f2mUg",
  rawId: "q2Xx0w8bRk6nV8yQ0f2mUg",
  type: "public-key",
  response: { clientDataJSON: "A".repeat(200), authenticatorData: "A".repeat(50), signature: "A".repeat(96) },
  clientExtensionResults: {},
};

describe("auth primitives", () => {
  test("email is trimmed and lowercased, invalid rejected", () => {
    expect(Email.parse("  Alice@Example.COM ")).toBe("alice@example.com");
    expect(Email.safeParse("not-an-email").success).toBe(false);
    expect(Email.safeParse(`${"a".repeat(250)}@x.io`).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("opaque ids are exactly 43 base64url characters", () => {
    expect(OpaqueId.safeParse(flow).success).toBe(true);
    expect(OpaqueId.safeParse("a".repeat(42)).success).toBe(false);
    expect(OpaqueId.safeParse(`${"a".repeat(42)}=`).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("device ids are 22 to 64 url-safe characters", () => {
    expect(DeviceId.safeParse("x".repeat(22)).success).toBe(true);
    expect(DeviceId.safeParse("x".repeat(21)).success).toBe(false);
    expect(DeviceId.safeParse("x".repeat(65)).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("recovery codes are normalised to lowercase base32 groups", () => {
    expect(RecoveryCode.parse(" ABCD-EF23-GH45 ")).toBe("abcd-ef23-gh45");
    expect(RecoveryCode.safeParse("abcd-ef01-gh45").success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("display names reject control characters and more than 50 characters", () => {
    expect(DisplayName.parse("  Ada Lovelace ")).toBe("Ada Lovelace");
    expect(DisplayName.safeParse(`bad${String.fromCharCode(7)}name`).success).toBe(false);
    expect(DisplayName.safeParse("x".repeat(51)).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("phone numbers are E.164 once spaces, hyphens and parentheses are dropped", () => {
    expect(Phone.parse(" +44 7911 123-456 ")).toBe("+447911123456");
    expect(Phone.parse("+1 (415) 555-0132")).toBe("+14155550132");
    expect(Phone.parse("+1234567")).toBe("+1234567");
    expect(Phone.parse(`+${"9".repeat(15)}`)).toBe(`+${"9".repeat(15)}`);
    // No plus, a leading zero, too short, too long, letters, a plus in the middle.
    for (const bad of ["447911123456", "+0447911123456", "+123456", `+${"9".repeat(16)}`, "+44 7911 ext 12", "44+7911123456", ""]) {
      expect(Phone.safeParse(bad).success, bad).toBe(false);
    }
  });
});

describe("auth requests and responses", () => {
  test("email verify response is discriminated by result", () => {
    expect(EmailVerifyResponse.parse({ result: "signup_required" })).toEqual({ result: "signup_required" });
    expect(EmailVerifyResponse.parse({ result: "mfa_required", mfaTicket: flow }).result).toBe("mfa_required");
    expect(EmailVerifyResponse.safeParse({ result: "session" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(EmailVerifyResponse.parse({ result: "session", mustReenrollMfa: false })).toEqual({ result: "session", mustReenrollMfa: false });
  });
  test("mfa verify takes exactly one of code or recoveryCode", () => {
    expect(MfaVerifyRequest.safeParse({ mfaTicket: flow, code: "123456" }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(MfaVerifyRequest.safeParse({ mfaTicket: flow, recoveryCode: "abcd-ef23-gh45" }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(MfaVerifyRequest.safeParse({ mfaTicket: flow, code: "123456", recoveryCode: "abcd-ef23-gh45" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(MfaVerifyRequest.safeParse({ mfaTicket: flow }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("reauth accepts password, totp, email, recovery and passkey methods only", () => {
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "password", password: "x" }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "totp", code: "000000" }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "email", flowId: flow, code: "000000" }).success).toBe(true);
    // A recovery code (1c design, section 7.2), normalised as the MFA step normalises it.
    expect(ReauthRequest.parse({ method: "recovery", recoveryCode: " ABCD-EF23-GH45 " })).toEqual({ method: "recovery", recoveryCode: "abcd-ef23-gh45" });
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "recovery", recoveryCode: "abcd-ef01-gh45" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "recovery", code: "000000" }).success).toBe(false);
    // A passkey re-authentication carries an assertion (1c design, section 7.2); a registration is not one.
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "passkey", response: reauthAssertion }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "passkey" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "passkey", response: { ...reauthAssertion, response: {} } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ReauthRequest.safeParse({ method: "sms", code: "000000" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("the reauth answer carries the level reached, the rotated token for native clients and, after a recovery code, the re-enrolment flag", () => {
    expect(ReauthResponse.parse({ level: 1 })).toEqual({ level: 1 });
    expect(ReauthResponse.parse({ level: 2, token: "kb1_x", mustReenrollMfa: true })).toEqual({ level: 2, token: "kb1_x", mustReenrollMfa: true });
    expect(ReauthResponse.safeParse({ level: 3 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ReauthResponse.safeParse({ level: "2" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ReauthResponse.safeParse({ token: "kb1_x" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("turning TOTP off takes an empty body: the re-authentication already spent the code, and a code sent anyway is dropped", () => {
    expect(TotpDisableRequest.parse({})).toEqual({});
    expect(TotpDisableRequest.parse({ code: "123456" })).toEqual({});
    expect(TotpDisableRequest.safeParse(null).success).toBe(false);
    expect(TotpDisableRequest.safeParse("code").success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("signup completion needs an ISO calendar date", () => {
    expect(SignupCompleteRequest.safeParse({ flowId: flow, dateOfBirth: "2008-02-29", termsVersion: "draft" }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(SignupCompleteRequest.safeParse({ flowId: flow, dateOfBirth: "29/02/2008", termsVersion: "draft" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("a listed session is named by its handle, a uuid that stays while its token rotates, and never by the token's hash", () => {
    const session = { id: userId, deviceLabel: "Chrome on Windows", platform: "web", createdAt: "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z", lastUsedAt: "2026-09-24T10:05:00.000Z", current: true };
    expect(SessionsResponse.parse({ sessions: [session, { ...session, id: "0b0e7c1a-5a53-4f0e-8a3f-2f6f8f5d9c11", platform: "ios", current: false }] }).sessions.map((s) => [s.id, s.current])).toEqual([
      [userId, true],
      ["0b0e7c1a-5a53-4f0e-8a3f-2f6f8f5d9c11", false],
    ]);
    // What the list carried before: sha256 of the token, which a rotation replaces, so a listed session could not be revoked after one.
    expect(SessionInfo.safeParse({ ...session, id: "a".repeat(64) }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SessionInfo.safeParse({ ...session, id: "not-a-uuid" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SessionInfo.safeParse({ ...session, id: undefined }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(SessionInfo.safeParse({ ...session, platform: "desktop" }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("me response carries email, the count of passkeys and a nullable profile", () => {
    const me = {
      user: { id: userId, email: "a@b.io", role: "user", onboarded: false, mfaEnabled: false, hasPassword: false, passkeys: 0 },
      profile: null,
      standing: null,
      avatar: null,
    };
    expect(MeResponse.parse(me)).toEqual(me);
    // 2d Task 3 (9.3): the account's own avatar, its two paths or null, always present.
    const avatar = { small: `/api/media/${userId}/small.webp`, large: `/api/media/${userId}/large.webp` };
    expect(MeResponse.parse({ ...me, avatar }).avatar).toEqual(avatar);
    const { avatar: _none, ...withoutAvatar } = me;
    expect(MeResponse.safeParse(withoutAvatar).success).toBe(false);
    // The count decides whether the app offers a passkey re-authentication and the suggestion card (1c design, section 9), so it is never left out.
    expect(MeResponse.parse({ ...me, user: { ...me.user, passkeys: 3 } }).user.passkeys).toBe(3);
    expect(MeResponse.safeParse({ ...me, user: { ...me.user, passkeys: undefined } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(MeResponse.safeParse({ ...me, user: { ...me.user, passkeys: -1 } }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(MeResponse.safeParse({ ...me, user: { ...me.user, passkeys: 1.5 } }).success).toBe(false);

  test("the own profile in the me response says when the handle last changed, whether the badge is held and whether the account's posts show in Explore", () => {
    const user = { id: userId, email: "a@b.io", role: "user", onboarded: true, mfaEnabled: false, hasPassword: false, passkeys: 0 };
    const profile = { id: userId, handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", handleChangedAt: null, verified: false, showInExplore: true, sharePreviews: false };
    expect(MeResponse.parse({ user, profile, standing: null, avatar: null })).toEqual({ user, profile, standing: null, avatar: null });
    expect(MeProfile.parse({ ...profile, handleChangedAt: "2026-09-24T10:00:00.000Z", verified: true }).verified).toBe(true);

    expect(MeProfile.parse({ ...profile, showInExplore: false }).showInExplore).toBe(false);

    expect(MeResponse.safeParse({ user, profile: { id: userId, handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada" }, standing: null, avatar: null }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(MeProfile.safeParse({ ...profile, handleChangedAt: "yesterday" }).success).toBe(false);

    expect(MeProfile.parse({ ...profile, sharePreviews: true }).sharePreviews).toBe(true);
    expect(MeProfile.safeParse({ ...profile, sharePreviews: undefined }).success).toBe(false);
  });
  test("every documented auth error code exists", () => {
    expect(AuthErrorCode.options).toHaveLength(35);
    // 3e (design, section 10.5): a handle korbat retired, refused to everyone, its former holder included.
    expect(AuthErrorCode.options).toContain("handle_retired");
    expect(AuthErrorCode.options).toContain("password_check_unavailable");
    expect(AuthErrorCode.options).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(["handle_cooldown", "email_in_use", "phone_in_use", "badge_unavailable", "verify_unavailable"]));
    // Passkeys (1c design, section 8).
    expect(AuthErrorCode.options).toEqual(
      expect.arrayContaining(["passkey_invalid", "passkey_unsupported", "passkey_limit", "passkey_suspended", "passkey_not_found", "challenge_expired"]),
    );
  });
});

describe("account lifecycle requests and responses", () => {

    expect(BadgeVerifyRequest.parse({ flowId: flow, code: "000000" })).toEqual({ flowId: flow, code: "000000" });
    expect(BadgeVerifyRequest.safeParse({ flowId: flow, code: "abcdef" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(BadgeVerifyRequest.safeParse({ flowId: flow, code: "0000000" }).success).toBe(false);

  test("deletion starts with a flow id and is confirmed with the code and the typed handle", () => {
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "vitest";
import * as contracts from "../src/index";
import { EXPLORE_V2, ExplorePage, ExploreSettingResponse, ExploreStatus, ExploreStatusKind, TimelineItem, type ExploreFormula } from "../src/index";

const id = (n: number) => `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(n).padStart(12, "0")}`;
const author = { id: id(1), handle: "ada", displayName: "Ada", verified: false, avatar: null };
const post = (n: number, extra: Record<string, unknown> = {}) => ({
  id: id(n),
  author,
  body: "hello",
  createdAt: "2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z",
  state: "visible",
  replyTo: null,
  counts: { likes: 3, reposts: 1, replies: 0, quotes: 0 },
  media: [],
  quoteOf: null,
  imported: null,
  mentions: [],
  countsHidden: false,
  ...extra,
});
const at = "2026-09-28T12:05:00.000Z";
const repost = { kind: "repost", post: post(2), repostedBy: author, repostedAt: at };

describe("the Explore formula", () => {
  /** The day formula version 2 reached the repository (3e design, sections 9.7 and 10.1). */
  const V2_DATE = "2026-10-12";

  test("EXPLORE_V2 holds the numbers of the 2c design, section 5, unchanged, version 2 and both entries of the change log", () => {
    expect(EXPLORE_V2).toStrictEqual({
      version: 2,
      windowHours: 48,
      engagerMinAgeHours: 48,
      standingMinutes: 10,
      threshold: 3,
      gravity: 1.8,
      offsetHours: 2,
      perAuthor: 2,
      listLength: 300,
      refreshMinutes: 5,
      minGapMinutes: 4.5,
      kept: 2,
      signedOutPage: 20,
      changes: [
        { version: 1, date: "2026-09-28", summary: "First version." },
        {
          version: 2,
          date: V2_DATE,
          summary:
            "Posts of suspended accounts are not ranked, and a suspended account's likes and reposts do not count. A post that moderation hid and then restored gets back the time it was hidden.",
        },
      ],
    });
  });

  test("EXPLORE_V1 is no longer exported: version 2 is the one formula the code ranks and words with", () => {
    expect(Object.keys(contracts)).toContain("EXPLORE_V2");
    expect(Object.keys(contracts)).not.toContain("EXPLORE_V1");
  });

  test("EXPLORE_V2 is frozen all the way down, so nothing at run time can change the published numbers", () => {
    expect(Object.isFrozen(EXPLORE_V2)).toBe(true);
    expect(Object.isFrozen(EXPLORE_V2.changes)).toBe(true);
    for (const change of EXPLORE_V2.changes) expect(Object.isFrozen(change)).toBe(true);
    // Modules run in strict mode, where writing to a frozen object throws instead of failing silently.
    expect(() => {
      (EXPLORE_V2 as { threshold: number }).threshold = 1;
    }).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(() => {
      (EXPLORE_V2.changes as unknown as unknown[]).push({ version: 3, date: "2026-12-01", summary: "Changed." });
    }).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(() => {
      (EXPLORE_V2.changes[1] as { summary: string }).summary = "Changed.";
    }).toThrow(TypeError);
    expect(EXPLORE_V2.threshold).toBe(3);
    expect(EXPLORE_V2.changes).toHaveLength(2);
  });

  test("the change log runs oldest first and ends with the formula's own version", () => {
    expect(EXPLORE_V2.changes.map((change) => change.version)).toEqual([1, 2]);
    expect(EXPLORE_V2.changes.at(-1)?.version).toBe(EXPLORE_V2.version);
  });

  test("a formula with other numbers has the same type, so the refresh can take one, and EXPLORE_V2 is untouched", () => {
    const changed: ExploreFormula = { ...EXPLORE_V2, threshold: 5, perAuthor: 1, listLength: 10, minGapMinutes: 0 };
    expect(changed).toMatchObject({ version: 2, threshold: 5, perAuthor: 1, listLength: 10, minGapMinutes: 0, gravity: 1.8 });
    expect(EXPLORE_V2).toMatchObject({ threshold: 3, perAuthor: 2, listLength: 300, minGapMinutes: 4.5 });
  });
});

describe("the Explore page", () => {
  test("carries post items, the cursor, the time the ranking was computed and the sign-in prompt", () => {
    const page = {
      items: [
        { kind: "post", post: post(1) },
        // A signed-in reader's items carry their own like, repost and bookmark flags, as on every list.
        { kind: "post", post: post(3, { viewer: { liked: true, reposted: false, bookmarked: false } }) },
      ],
      // Opaque to the contract: the API's Explore cursor names a ranking and the last post read.
      nextCursor: "opaque-cursor",
      computedAt: at,
      signInForMore: false,
    };
    expect(ExplorePage.parse(page)).toEqual(page);
  });

  test("before the first round it is empty, with no cursor and no time; a signed-out page may end in the sign-in prompt", () => {
    const empty = { items: [], nextCursor: null, computedAt: null, signInForMore: false };
    expect(ExplorePage.parse(empty)).toEqual(empty);
    const signedOut = { items: [{ kind: "post", post: post(1) }], nextCursor: null, computedAt: at, signInForMore: true };
    expect(ExplorePage.parse(signedOut)).toEqual(signedOut);
  });

  test("refuses a repost item, which is a valid timeline item elsewhere: Explore lists original posts only", () => {
    expect(TimelineItem.safeParse(repost).success).toBe(true);
    const base = { nextCursor: null, computedAt: at, signInForMore: false };
    expect(ExplorePage.safeParse({ ...base, items: [repost] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExplorePage.safeParse({ ...base, items: [{ kind: "post", post: post(1) }, repost] }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExplorePage.safeParse({ ...base, items: [{ kind: "post" }] }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("needs every field, with its type", () => {
    const page = { items: [], nextCursor: null, computedAt: at, signInForMore: false };
    for (const key of Object.keys(page)) {
      const partial: Record<string, unknown> = { ...page };
      delete partial[key];
      expect(ExplorePage.safeParse(partial).success, key).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(ExplorePage.safeParse({ ...page, computedAt: "five minutes ago" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExplorePage.safeParse({ ...page, computedAt: "2026-09-28" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExplorePage.safeParse({ ...page, nextCursor: 2 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExplorePage.safeParse({ ...page, signInForMore: "no" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("shows only the order: no score, rank or count beside the items, the cursor, the time and the prompt", () => {
    expect(Object.keys(ExplorePage.shape).sort()).toEqual(["computedAt", "items", "nextCursor", "signInForMore"]);
  });
});

describe("the author's Explore status", () => {
  test("names one of fourteen reasons, in the order the status route tries them: suspended after not_visible (3e), imported after quote (3b)", () => {
    expect(ExploreStatusKind.options).toEqual([
      "reply",
      "quote",
      "imported",
      "not_visible",
      "suspended",
      "hidden_by_author",
      "listed",
      "outside_window",
      "no_ranking",
      "new_since_ranking",
      "below_threshold",
      "pending",
      "author_cap",
      "below_cutoff",
    ]);
  });

  test("carries the status and the time of the ranking it was judged against, which is null before the first round", () => {
    for (const status of ExploreStatusKind.options) {
      expect(ExploreStatus.parse({ status, computedAt: at }), status).toEqual({ status, computedAt: at });
    }
    expect(ExploreStatus.parse({ status: "no_ranking", computedAt: null })).toEqual({ status: "no_ranking", computedAt: null });
  });

  test("refuses an unknown status, a missing field and a time that is not an ISO datetime", () => {
    // No lever acts on Explore alone: moderation reaches it only through the post's state, which is not_visible.
    expect(ExploreStatus.safeParse({ status: "hidden_by_moderator", computedAt: at }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExploreStatus.safeParse({ status: "Listed", computedAt: at }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExploreStatus.safeParse({ status: "listed" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExploreStatus.safeParse({ computedAt: at }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExploreStatus.safeParse({ status: "listed", computedAt: "now" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  test("carries no count: its fields are exactly the status and the time", () => {
    expect(Object.keys(ExploreStatus.shape).sort()).toEqual(["computedAt", "status"]);
  });
});

describe("the author's Explore switch", () => {

    expect(ExploreSettingResponse.parse({ showInExplore: false })).toEqual({ showInExplore: false });
    expect(ExploreSettingResponse.safeParse({}).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExploreSettingResponse.safeParse({ showInExplore: "on" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(ExploreSettingResponse.safeParse({ showInExplore: null }).success).toBe(false);
```
